म: म The twenty-fifth consonant of the Nāgari alphabet, corresponding to the letter M.

म m. (-मः) 	 1. A name of BRAHMĀ. 	 2. ŚIVA. 	 3. VISHṆU. 	 4. YAMA. 	 5. Time, season. 	 6. Poison, venom. 	 7. A magical or mystical verse or formula. 	 8. The moon. 	 9. The abbreviated name of the fourth note of the gamut. 	 f. (मा) 	 1. A name of LAKSHMĪ. 	 2. A mother. 3. Measure. 	 4. Light, lustre. 	 5. Knowledge. 	 6. Binding, tying. 	 7. Death. 	 8. A woman's waist. 	 n. (-मं) 	 1. Good-fortune, auspicious-ness. 	 2. Water.  E. मा to measure, क aff.; or मन् to worship, &c., aff. ड.
मक्: मक् (इ) मकि r. 1st cl. (मङ्कते) 	 1. To decorate, to grace or adorn. 	 2. To go, to move.
मकर: मकर m. (-रः) 	 1. A marine monster, confounded usually with the crocodile and shark, but properly a fabulous animal: as a fish it might be conjectured to be the horned-shark, or the unicorn fish; but it is often drawn, as it in the pictured sign Capricornus of the zodiac, with the head and forelegs of an antelope, and the body and tail of a fish: it is the emblem of the god of love. 	 2. One of the signs of zodiac, corresponding with the above, and like the Greek representation of that sign, being an animal in the foreparts, and ending in the tail of a fish. One of the nine treasures of KUVERA. 	 3. A particular array of troops, in the form of a Makara. 	 4. An ear-ring in that shape.  E. म for मुख the mouth, कृ to scatter, aff. अच्; or माङ् prohibitive aff., कृ to do, अच् aff., form irr.; grammarians however, sometimes consider this word as a primitive.
मकरकेतन: मकरकेतन m. (-नः) KĀMA, the Hindu CUPID.  E. मकर, a marine monster and केतन emblem; being painted on KĀMA'S banner.
मकरकेतु: मकरकेतु m. (-तुः) KĀMA: see the preceding.  E. मकर, and केतु an emblem.
मकरध्वज: मकरध्वज m. (-जः) 	 1. KĀMA: see the two last. 	 2. A particular array of troops. 	 3. A particular medical preparation.  E. मकर Makara, and ध्वज emblem.
मकरन्द: मकरन्द m. (-न्दः) 	 1. The nectar or honey of a flower. 	 2. The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 	 3. A bee. 	 4. A fragrant kind of mango. 	 5. A kind of jasmine, (Jasminum pubescens.) 	 6. The filament of a lotus. E. मकर the emblem of KĀMA, and दो to destroy, i. e. to surpass, as an incentive to love, aff. क, form irr.
मकरन्दवती: मकरन्दवती f. (-ती) The trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. मकरन्द honey, and मतुप् aff., fem. form. “पाटला वृक्षे” ।
मकरसप्तमी: मकरसप्तमी f. (-मी) The seventh day in the first half of the month māgha.
मकराकर: मकराकर m. (-रः) The ocean.  E. मकर a marine monster, and आकर receptacle.
मकराकार: मकराकार m. (-रः) A plant, said to be a species of Karanja or Cæsal-pinia.  E. मकर a fish, आकार form. “कांँटा करम्जा” ।
मकराङ्क: मकराङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) 	 1. KĀMADEVA. 	 2. The ocean.  E. मकर a marine mons-ter. and अङ्क mark, emblem.
मकरालय: मकरालय m. (-यः) The ocean.  E. मकर a sort of fish, and आलय abode.
मकराश्व: मकराश्व m. (-श्वः) VARUṆA.  E. मकर a marine monster, and अश्व a horse; riding on the Makara.
मकरिन्: मकरिन् m. (-री) The ocean.  E. मकर a marine monster, and इनि aff.
मकुट: मकुट n. (-टं) A crest, a head-dress, a crown, a tiara.  E. मकि to adorn, aff. उट form irr.
मकुति: मकुति f. (-तिः) An edict or order of the government, addressed to the Sūdra tribe, or to a Sūdra.  E. मकि-उति ।
मकुर: मकुर m. (-रः) 	 1. A mirror. 	 2. The stick of a potter's wheel. 	 3. An un-blown flower. 	 4. A tree with light yellow, and fragrant flowers, (Mimusops elengi.)  E. मकि to adorn, उरच् Unādi aff. and deriv. irr.; also मुकुर ।
मकुल: मकुल m. (-लः) 	 1. An opening bud. 	 2. A kind of tree, (Mimusops elen-gi.)  E. मकि to adorn, उलच् aff., deriv. irr. “वकुल वृक्षे ।”
मकुष्टक: मकुष्टक m. (-कः) A kind of kidney-bean, a wild variety, perhaps of the Phaseolus mungo.  E. मकु irrly. derivd, from मक् to adorn, ष्टक् to impede, aff. अच्; also मकुष्ठक ।
मकुष्ठ: मकुष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्टा-ष्ठं) Going lazily, slowly, &c. 	 m. (-ष्ठः) A sort of rice. E. मकि to adorn, aff. उ, deriv. irr. मकु, and स्था to stand, aff. क. also मुकुष्ठ ।
मकुष्ठक: मकुष्ठक m. (-कः) A sort of kidney-bean.  E. मकु ornament: (see the two last;) स्था to stay or be, aff. क्वुन् ।
मकूलक: मकूलक m. (-कः) A plant commonly Dantī.  E. मकि to adorn, ऊलच् aff. and कन् added.
मक्क्: मक्क् r. 	 1. cl. (मक्कते) To go, to move.
मक्कूल: मक्कूल n. (-लं) A mineral substance, considered variously to be chalk or benzoin.  E. मक्क् to go, to be, aff. ऊलच् । “शिलाजतु” ।
मक्कोल: मक्कोल m. (-लः) Chalk: see the last.  E. मक्क् to go, ओलच् aff.
मक्ष्: मक्ष् r. 1st cl. (मक्षति) 	 1. To fill. 	 2. To be angry. 	 3. To mix, to combine.
मक्ष: मक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. Hypocrisy, slyness, concealment of one's own defects. 2. Multitude.  E. मक्ष् to fill. aff. अच् ।
मक्षिका: मक्षिका f. (-का) A fly.  E. मक्ष् to be angry, Unādi aff. सिकन्; or मक्ष् the same, क्कुन् aff.
मक्षीका: मक्षीका f. (-का) A fly. E. See the last, the pen. vowel made long.
मख: मख r. 1st cl. (मखति) also (इ) मखि (मङ्क्षति) To go, to move.
मख m. (-खः) Sacrifice, oblation.  E. मख् to go, aff. घञ् or घ ।
मखत्रातृ: मखत्रातृ m. (-ता) RĀMA, the son of DASARATHA, and second incarnation of VISHṆU so named.  E. मख sacrifice, and त्रातृ who preserves; his first exploit being the discomfiture of the Rākshasas, who dis-turbed the sacrifices of VISWĀMITRA.
मखवह्नि: मखवह्नि m. (-ह्निः) Sacrificial-fire.  E. मख sacrifice, and वह्नि fire; also similar compounds, as मखाग्नि &c.
मखानल: मखानल m. (-लः) Sacrificial-fire.  E. मख and अनल fire.
मखासुहृद्: मखासुहृद् m. (-द) ŚIVA.  E. मख् sacrifice, here meaning the sacrifice offered by DAKSHA and असुहृद् unfriendly; having disturbed the ceremony, and slain the sacrificer.
मग्: मग् (इ) मगि r. 1st cl. (मङ्गति) To go, to move.
मगध: मगध m. (-धः) 	 1. A country, South Behar. 	 2. An inhabitant of that country. 	 3. A bard, whose peculiar province is to sing the praises of a chief's ancestry in his presence, a family bard or minstrel. 	 f. (-धा) 	 1. Long pepper. 	 2. The town of the Magadhas.  E. मगध a Kandwādi verb, to ask, aff. अच्; or मगध the country, अण् aff., with alteration of the vowel optional; hence also मागध ।
मगधेश्वर: मगधेश्वर m. (-रः) A name of JARA SANDHA.  E. मगध South Bihar, ईश्वर king.
मग्न: मग्न mfn. (-ग्नः-ग्ना-ग्नं) 	 1. Plunged, dived, immersed. 	 2. Sunk, drowned. 	 3. Absorbed.  E. मस्ज् to plunge into water, aff. क्त.
मघ्: मघ् (इ) मघि r. 1st cl. (मङ्घते) 	 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To begin moving. 	 3. To begin. 	 4. To move swiftly. 	 5. To blame. 	 6. To gamble. 	 7. To cheat, to be addicted to dishonest practices. (मङ्घति) To decorate, to adorn.
मघ: मघ m. (-घः) 	 1. One of the Dwīpas or divisions of the universe. 	 2. A country, that of the modern Mugs, or Ārrākān. 	 3. A drug. 	 4. Pleasure, happiness. 	 5. A kind of medicine. 	 n. (-घं) A kind of flower. 	 f. (-घा) The tenth lunar asterism, containing five stars figured by a house: it is sometimes considered to be confined to the plural number. (मघाः) 	 f. (-घा-घी) A sort of grain.  E. मह to wor-ship, aff. कन् and ह changed to घ; or मघि-अच् पृषो० ।
मघवत्: मघवत् m. (-वान्) A name of INDRA.  E. मघ happiness, (of paradise or Swarga,) मतुप् aff.
मघवन्: मघवन् m. (-वा) 	 1. INDRA. 	 2. One of the twelve Chakravartis, or uni-versal monarchs of the Jainas. 	 3. An epithet of Vyāsa 4. An owl. E. मह to sacrifice, कनिन् Unādi aff. and वुक् augment, form irr.; before the vowel affs. of the second case plural, and the last five cases, the व of this word is changed to उ, and thence becomes ओ as usual, as मघोनः, मघोना, मघोने, &c.; also with ङीष् aff. the fem. form is मघीनी f. (-नी) Sāchi, the wife of INDRA.
मघाभव: मघाभव m. (-वः) The planet VENUS.  E. मघा the asterism, and भव born.
मघाभू: मघाभू m. (-भूः) SUKRA.  E. मघा and भू born; see the last.
मङ्किल: मङ्किल m. (-लः) A fire in a forest.  E. मकि to adorn, aff. इलच् ।
मङ्कुर: मङ्कुर m. (-रः) A mirror.  E. मकि to adorn, उरच् aff., and the nasal re-tained; also मकुर and मुकुर ।
मङ्क्तृ: मङ्क्तृ mfn. (-क्ता-क्त्री-क्तृ) 	 1. Bathing or drowning; any thing, or person. 2. Cleaning any thing by immersion.  E. मस्ज् to bathe, aff. तृच्, and नुम् augment.
मङ्क्षण: मङ्क्षण n. (-णं) Cuisses or greaves, armour for the thighs or legs.  E. मङ्क्ष-ल्युट् aff.; it is sometimes read मङ्क्षुण ।
मङ्क्षु: मङ्क्षु Ind. 	 1. Quickly, Swiftly, instantly. 	 2. Much, exceedingly.  E. मस्ज् to purify, सु aff., and नुम् augment; also मङ्खु.  E. मखि-उन् ।
मङ्क्षुण: मङ्क्षुण n. (-णं) Cuisses or greaves, armour for the thighs or legs; a sort of iron chain-work petticoat, coming down to the knees, is still worn in some parts of India.
मङ्ख: मङ्ख m. (-ङ्खः) 	 1. A royal bard. 	 2. A mendicant of a particular order.  E. मखि to go, अच् aff.
मङ्ग: मङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The head of a boat.  E. मगि to go, aff. अच् ।
मङ्गल: मङ्गल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 	 1. Lucky, fortunate, prosperous, faring well or happily. 	 2. Brave. 	 n. (-लं) 	 1. Happiness, good-fortune. 	 2. Preserving property, taking care of what has been gained. 	 3. Prudence, care-fulness. 	 3. A good woman. 	 4. Festivity. 	 5. Turmeric. 	 6. An ancient custom. 	 m. (-लः) 	 1. The planet MARS. 	 2. Burnt offering on various occasions of rejoicing. 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A name of UMĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. 	 2. A bent grass, (Panicum dactylon,) with white blossoms. 3. A virtuous and obedient wife. 	 4. The mother of the fifth Jina or Jaina teacher SUMATĪ. 	 5. A species of Cæsalpinia.  E. मगि to go, अलच् Unādi aff.
मङ्गलच्छाय: मङ्गलच्छाय m. (-यः) Waved-leaf fig-tree, (Ficus infectoria.)  E. मङ्गल pros-perous, lucky, and छाया shade.
मङ्गलपाठक: मङ्गलपाठक m. (-कः) A bard, an encomiast.  E. मङ्गल good fortune, and पाठक who reads or recites.
मङ्गलप्रतिसर: मङ्गलप्रतिसर m. (-रः) 	 1. An auspicious string worn by married women round the neck. 	 2. The cord of an amulet.
मङ्गलप्रदा: मङ्गलप्रदा f. (-दा) Turmeric.  E. मङ्गल auspiciousness, and प्रदा bestowing.
मङ्गलाक्षत: मङ्गलाक्षत m. (-तः) Rice thrown by Brāhmans upon people in bestow-ing a blessing.
मङ्गलाचरण: मङ्गलाचरण n. (-णं) An auspicious introduction in the shape of a prayer at the beginning of an undertaking or of any written work.
मङ्गलाष्टक: मङ्गलाष्टक n. (-कं) A benedictory stanza repeated by priests for good luck on the bride and bridegroom at the time of wedding.
मङ्गल्य: मङ्गल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 	 1. Auspicious, propitious, conferring happi-ness, prosperity, &c. 	 2. Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable. 	 2. Pure, pious. 	 m. (-ल्यः) 	 1. A plant, commonly Trayamāna. 	 2. The holy fig-tree, (Ficus religiosa.) 	 3. The Vilwa, (Ægle marme-los.) 	 4. A sort of pulse, (Cicer lens.) 	 5. The cocoanut-tree. 	 f. (-ल्या) 	 1. A fragrant sort of Agallochum or aloe wood. 	 2. A kind of Mimosa, (M. Suma, Rox.) 	 3. A herb, commonly Gojihvā, (Hieracium or according to Rox's Catalogue, a herb of the same class, Elephantopus scaber.) 	 4. A sort of grass, (Andropogun aciculatum.) 	 5. A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) 6. A sort or perfume, commonly Rochanā. 	 7. A kind of Orris root, (Acorus calamus.) 	 n. (-ल्यं) 	 1. Sour curds. 	 2. Sandal. 	 3. Red lead. 4. Gold. 	 5. Water brought from various sacred places for the coronation of a king.  E. मङ्गल prosperous and यत् aff.
मङ्गल्यक: मङ्गल्यक m. (-कः) Lentils, (Cicer lens.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
मङ्गल्यनामधेया: मङ्गल्यनामधेया f. (-या) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.)  E. मङ्गल्य auspicious, नामधेया appellation.
मङ्गिनी: मङ्गिनी f. (-नी) A boat.  E. मङ्ग the head of a boat, aff. इनि ।
मच्: मच् also (इ) मचि r. 1st cl. (मचते मञ्चते) 	 1. To be vain or proud. 	 2. To be wicked. 	 3. To speak. 	 4. To pound or grind. मचि r. 1st cl. (मञ्चते) 1. To hold or have. 	 2. To be high or tall. 	 3. To revere, to adore, to worship. 	 4. To shine.
मचर्चिका: मचर्च्चिका f. (-का) 	 1. Excellence, happiness. 	 2. (In apposition,) Best, excellent, (the gender is unchanged.)  E. म ŚIVA, चर्च्च to worship, affs. ण्वुल् and टाप् ।
मचर्च्चिका: मचर्च्चिका f. (-का) 	 1. Excellence, happiness. 	 2. (In apposition,) Best, excellent, (the gender is unchanged.)  E. म ŚIVA, चर्च्च to worship, affs. ण्वुल् and टाप् ।
मच्चित्त: मच्चित्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Who or what has the mind fixed on me, (God.) E. मत् me, चित्त mind.
मच्छ: मच्छ m. (-च्छः) A fish in general.  E. मद् to delight, and श aff., form irr. see मत्स्य ।
मज्जकृत्: मज्जकृत् n. (-कृत्) A bone.  E. मज्ज marrow and कृत् what makes.
मज्जत्: मज्जत् mfn. (-ज्जन्-ज्जन्ती-ज्जत्) Plunging in or into, being immersed, dip-ping, drowning.  E. मस्ज् to be immersed, शतृ aff.
मज्जन्: मज्जन् m. (-ज्जा) 	 1. The marrow of the bone and flesh. 	 2. The pith or sap of trees, &c.  E. सस्ज् to be immersed, (in the centre of the bones, &c.) and कनिन् Unādi aff.
मज्जन: मज्जन n. (-नं) 	 1. Bathing, ablution. 	 2. Immersion. 	 3. Drowning. 	 4. Marrow.  E. मस्ज् to bathe, &c. aff. ल्युट् ।
मज्जसमुद्भव: मज्जसमुद्भव n. (-वं) Semen Virile.  E. मज्ज marrow, समुद्भव production.
मज्जा: मज्जा f. (-ज्जा) Marrow, pith, sap.  E. मज्जन् marrow and अच्-टाप् aff.: see मज्जन् ।
मज्जिका: मज्जिका f. (-का) The female of the Indian crane.
मज्जषा: मज्ज षा f. (-षा) A basket. E. See मञ्जूषा ।
मञ्च्: मञ्च् (उ) मञ्चु r. 1st cl. (मञ्चति) To go.
मञ्च: मञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) 	 1. A bed, a bedstead 2. A platform, a scaffold. 	 3. An ele-vated shed raised on bamboos in a cornfield, &c., where a watch-man is stationed to protect the corn from cattle, birds, wild beasts, &c. 	 4. A sort of throne or chair of state, or the platform on which it is raised, the dais.  E. मचि to be high or tall, aff. धञ् ।
मञ्चक: मञ्चक m. (-कः) 	 1. A bed, a bedstead. 	 2. A platform, a scaffold. 	 3. A stand for holding fire.  E. कन् added to the preceding.
मञ्चकाश्रय: मञ्चकाश्रय m. (-यः) A bug.  E. मञ्चक a bed, and आश्रय abode.
मञ्चमण्डप: मञ्चमण्डप m. (-पः) A sort of temporary open shed, a platform erected for particular ceremonies, as marriages, &c.  E. मञ्च a scaffold, and मण्डप a temporary hall.
मञ्ज्: मञ्ज् r. 10th cl. (मञ्जयति) 	 1. To sound. 	 2. To clean, to purify.
मञ्जर: मञ्जर nf. (-रं-री) 	 1. A pearl. 	 2. A compound pedicle. 	 3. A sort of plant, commonly Tilaka.  E. मञ्जु beautiful, ऋ to go or be, aff. अप्, deriv. irr.; or मन्ज्-अरच् ।
मञ्जरि: मञ्जरि f. (-रिः-री) 	 1. A compound pedicle, a fruit or flower-stalk. 	 2. A A large pearl. 	 3. A plant, commonly Tilaka. 	 4. A line. 	 5. A creeper. 	 6. The holy-basil. 	 mf. (-रिः-री) A shoot, a sprout.  E. मञ्जु beautiful, ऋ to go, or be, aff. इ, deriv. irr., ङीप् optionally added.
मञ्जरित: मञ्जरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Mounted on a stalk, (a bud, &c.)  E. मञ्जर and इतच् aff.
मञ्जा: मञ्जा f. (-ञ्जा) 	 1. A compound pedicle: see the last. 	 2. A she-goat. 	 3. A creeper.  E. मजि to sound, aff. अच् ।
मञ्जि: मञ्जि f. (-ञ्जिः-ञ्जी) A compound pedicle; also मञ्जरी ।
मञ्जिका: मञ्जिका f. (-का) A harlot, a whore.  E. मजि-ण्वुलु-टाप् अत इत्त्वम् ।
मञ्जिफला: मञ्जिफला f. (-ला) The plantain, (Musa sapientum.)  E. मञ्जि a foot-stalk, and फल fruit.
मञ्जिमन्: मञ्जिमन् n. (म) Beauty, elegance.  E. मञ्जु handsome, इमनिच् aff.
मञ्जिष्ठा: मञ्जिष्ठा f. (-ष्ठा) Bengal madder, a plant used in medicine, and in dy-ing, (Rubia Manjith, Rox.)  E. मञ्जु beautiful, स्था to stay or be, क aff., deriv. irr.; or मञ्जि a compound pedicle, and स्थ aff.
मञ्जिष्ठाराग: मञ्जिष्ठाराग m. (-गः) 	 1. The dye of madder. 	 2. An attachment as dura-ble as the colour of the Indian madder, permanent attachment, (figuratively.)  E. मञ्जिष्ठा and राग colour.
मञ्जीर: मञ्जीर n. (-रं) An ornament for the feet or toes. 	 m. (-रः) A post, round which passes the string that works the stick of a churn.  E. मन्ज् to sound, aff. ईरन्; also with कन् added मञ्जीरक ।
मञ्जील: मञ्जील m. (-लः) 	 1. A village, inhabited chiefly by washermen. 	 2. An anklet.  E. मञ्ज् to sound, ईरन् aff. and र changed to ल ।
मञ्जु: मञ्जु mfn. (-ञ्जुः-ञ्जुः-ञ्जु) Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable.  E. मन्ज् to clean, aff. उन् ।

मणिभद्र: मणिभद्र m. (-द्रः) 	 1. One of the Jinas, or Jaina deified teachers. 	 2. A name of the king of the Yakshas.
मणिभित्ति: मणिभित्ति f. (-त्तिः) The place of the great serpent, SESHA Nāga.  E. मणि a jewel, and भित्ति a wall.

मणिवक: मणिवक n. (-कं) A flower.  E. मण् to sound. deriv. irr.

Surrounding or contiguous countries. 	 9. A sort of leprosy with circular spots. 	 10. A heap, a quantity, a multitude or assemblage. 	 11. An attitude in shooting, the fifth position, in which both knees are bent. 	 12. The impression or scratch of a finger-nail. 	 13. E. मण्डल a district, and ईश्चर a sovereign; the power of this prince is limited by AMARA, and the Mandaleswara is considered as an emperor or supreme prince, only when in addition to his territorial sway, he has performed the Rājasuya sacrifice, in which he has been attended by all his tributary or subject princes: other authorities confound the so-vereign of a Mandala, with the Chakravarti or emperor, and with the Samrāj or lord paramount, and others confine him to the government of a district of twenty or forty Yojanas in each direction.

मदोत्कट: मदोत्कट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) 	 1. Arrogant, haughty. 	 2. Furious, mad. 	 m. (-टः) 	 1. An elephant in rut. 	 2. A pigeon. 	 3. A dove. 	 f. (-टा) A spirituous liquor.  E. मद and उत्कट who is furious.
मदोदग्र: मदोदग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Haughty, arrogant. 	 f. (-ग्रा) A woman in gene-ral.  E. मद and उदग्र elevated.
मदोद्धत: मदोद्धत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Drunk, intoxicated. 	 2. Arrogant, drunk with pride.  E. मद drunkenness, उद्धत struck, overcome.
मदोन्मत्त: मदोन्मत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Drunk or mad with pride, passion, &c. E. मद and उन्मत्त mad.
मद्गु: मद्गु m. (-द्गुः) 	 1. An aquatic bird, the shag. 	 2. An outcaste, the son of a Brāhmana by a woman of the bard, or panegyrist class, whose employment is hunting wild beasts. 	 3. मद्गुरसी: मद्गुरसी f. (-सी) A sort of fish. “शृङ्गीमत्स्ये” ।
मद्य: मद्य n. (-द्यं) Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor. 	 f. (-द्या) 	 1. Intoxicating. 2. Gladdening.  E. मद to be intoxicated, (by it), aff. यत् ।
मद्यपङ्क: मद्यपङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) Vinous liquor for distilling.  E. मद्य wine, पङ्क mud.
मद्यपाशन: मद्यपाशन n. (-नं) Eating a relish, or what excites thirst.  E. मद्य wine, अश् to go, aff. ल्युट् ।
मद्यपीत: मद्यपीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Drunk, a drunkard.  E. मद्य and पीत drunk.
मद्यपुष्पी: मद्यपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A plant, the blossoms of which are used in distilling: see मद्यवासिनी, &c.  E. मद्य wine, पुष्प the flower. “धाइफुल् ।”
मद्यमण्ड: मद्यमण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Yeast, barm, froth.  E. मद्य wine, मण्ड froth, scum.
मद्यवासिनी: मद्यवासिनी f. (-नी) The Dhātuki creeper, the blossoms of which are used in distilling, (Grislea tomentosa, or Lythrum fruticosum.) E. मद्य wine, वस् to dwell, aff. णिनि and ङीष् ।
मद्यवीज: मद्यवीज n. (-जं) A drug used to produce fermentation.  E. मद्य wine, and वीज seed.
मद्यसन्धान: मद्यसन्धान n. (-नं) Distillation of spirits.  E. मद्य vinous liquor, and सन्धान distilling.
मद्र: मद्र m. (-द्रः) 	 1. Joy, delight. 	 2. A country enumerated amongst those to the N. W. of Hindustan proper. 	 3. A sovereign of that coun-try. 	 f. (-द्रा) The name of a river.  E. मदि to be delighted, Unādi aff. रक् ।
मद्रक: मद्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Produced, &c. in the country of Madra.  E. मद्र a country so named, and कन् aff.
मद्रकार: मद्रकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Delighting, giving delight.  E. मद्र delight, कृ to make, aff. अण्; also with खच् aff. मद्रङ्कर ।
मद्रसुता: मद्रसुता f. (-ता) The wife of Pāndu, mother of the two youngest Pāndu princes.  E. मद्र a proper name, and सुता the daughter.
मद्वन्: मद्वन् m. (-द्वा) A name of ŚIVA.  E. मद् to be intoxicated, वनिप् Unādi aff.
मद्वर्गीण: मद्वर्गीण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Connected with, or related to me.  E. मत् mine, वर्ग a class or number, ख aff.; also with छ aff. मद्वर्ग्गीय; and with यत्, मद्वर्ग्य ।
मधव्य: मधव्य m. (-व्यः) The lunar month Vaiśākha.
मधु: मधु mfn. (-धुः-ध्वी-धु) Sweet, literally or figuratively. 	 n. (-धु) 	 1. Spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia, or accor-ding to some explanations wine, or spirit distilled from grapes. 	 2. Honey. 	 3. The nectar, or honey of flowers. 	 4. Water. 	 5. Milk. 6. Sugar. 	 7. Sweetness, in flavour, sound, or disposition. 	 m. (-धुः) 1. The month Chaitra, (March-April.) 	 2. The season of spring. 3. A tree, (Bassia latifoliā.) 	 4. The name of Daitya or demon, slain by VISHṆU. 	 5. The Asoka tree, (Jonesia asoca.) 	 6. Liquo-rice. 	 7. The name of a RĀKSHASA killed by SATRUGHNA. 	 8. An epithet of king Kārtavirya. 	 f. (-धुः) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. मन् to mind or respect, Unādi aff. उ, and ध substituted for the final.
मधुक: मधुक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 	 1. Sweet, (in taste.) 	 2. Sweet-speaking or sounding, mellifluous, melodious. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A bard, a pane-gyrist, one who recites the lineage and praises of sovereigns in their presence. 	 2. A kind of bird. 	 3. A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 	 mn. (-कः-कं) Liquorice, &c. 	 n. (-कं) Tin. 	 f. (-का) 	 1. A plant, (Menis-permum glabrum.) 	 2. The sweet lime. 	 3. A kind of panic seed. E. मधु sweet, कै to sound, aff. ड; or मधु honey, कन् aff. of com-parison, &c.
मधुक m. (-कः) 	 1. A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 	 2. A bee. 	 n. (-कं) A flower of the Madhūka tree.  E. मन् to respect, ऊक aff., and ध substi-tuted for the final.
मधुकण्ठ: मधुकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.  E. मधु honey, (as sweet,) कण्ठ the throat.
मधुकर: मधुकर m. (-रः) 	 1. A bee. 	 2. A lover. 	 3. A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 4. A fruit, the round sweet lime.  E. मधु honey, and कर what makes.
मधुकर्कटिका: मधुकर्क्कटिका f. (-का) 	 1. A sort of citron, the round sweet lime. 	 2. A kind of date.  E. मधु honey and कर्क्कटी or कर्क्कटिका a cucumber; some authorities have मधुकुक्कुटिका in place of this word.
मधुकर्क्कटिका: मधुकर्क्कटिका f. (-का) 	 1. A sort of citron, the round sweet lime. 	 2. A kind of date.  E. मधु honey and कर्क्कटी or कर्क्कटिका a cucumber; some authorities have मधुकुक्कुटिका in place of this word.
मधुकारिन्: मधुकारिन् m. (-री) A bee.  E. मधु, and कारिन् who makes.
मधुकुक्कुटी: मधुकुक्कुटी f. (-टी) A kind of citron tree: see मधुकर्क्कटिका ।
मधुकुल्या: मधुकुल्या f. (-ल्या) A stream of honey.
मधुकृत्: मधुकृत् m. (-कृत्) A bee.  E. मधु honey, and कृत् what makes.
मधुकेशट: मधुकेशट m. (-टः) A bee.  E. मधुके in honey, and शट् to go, aff. अच् ।
मधुकोष: मधुकोष m. (-षः) The honey-comb or bee-hive.  E. मधु honey, कोष recep-tacle. Also मधुकोश.
मधुक्रम: मधुक्रम m. (-मः) 	 1. Tippling. 	 2. The honey-comb.  E. मधु wine or honey, and क्रम order, arrangement.
मधुक्षीर: मधुक्षीर m. (-रः) The date tree.  E. मधु honey, and क्षीर milk.
मधुघोष: मधुघोष m. (-षः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.  E. मधु sweet, and घोष voice.
मधुज: मधुज n. (-जं) Bee's wax. 	 f. (-जा) 	 1. The earth. 	 2. Clayed or candied sugar.  E. मधु honey, and ज produced.
मधुजम्बीर: मधुजम्बीर m. (-रः) A kind of citron. “कमलालेवु ।”
मधुजित्: मधुजित् m. (-जित्) VISHṆU or KRISHṆA.  E. मधु the demon so named, and जित् conqueror.
मधुतृण: मधुतृण n. (-णं) Sugar-cane.  E. मधु sweet, and तृण grass.
मधुत्रय: मधुत्रय n. (-यं) The three sweet things, viz.:--Clarified butter, honey and sugar.
मधुदीप: मधुदीप m. (-पः) KĀMA, the Hindu CUPID.  E. मधु spring, and दीप inflaming.
मधुद्गत: मधुद्गत m. (-तः) The mango tree.  E. मधु spring, and द्गत messenger; blossoming in spring.
मधुद्र: मधुद्र m. (-द्रः) 	 1. A bee. 	 2. A libertine.  E. मधु honey, द्रु to take, क aff., and the vowel changed.
मधुद्रव: मधुद्रव m. (-वः) A red variety of the Hyperanthera morunga.  E. मधु honey, and द्रव dropping.
मधुद्रुम: मधुद्रुम m. (-मः) 	 1. A tree, from the blossoms of which a spirit is dis-tilled, (Bassia latifolia.) 	 2. The mango tree.  E. मधु wine, द्रुम a tree.
मधुधातु: मधुधातु m. (-तुः) A sort of pyrites.  E. मधु honey, (as yellow,) and धातु mineral, honey-stone.
मधुधूलि: मधुधूलि f. (-लिः) Molasses, sugar before it is quite purified.  E. मधु honey, धूलि dust.
मधुनालिकेरक: मधुनालिकेरक m. (-कः) A sweet kind of cocoanut.  E. मधु sweet, नालिकेरक cocoanut.
मधुनेतृ: मधुनेतृ m. (-ता) A bee.  E. मधु honey, नी to get, तृच् aff.
मधुनोलीह: मधुनोलीह m. (-हः) A bee.  E. मधुनः of honey, लेह who licks.
मधुप: मधुप m. (-पः) A bee.  E. मधु honey, and प who drinks.
मधुपर्क: मधुपर्क n. (-र्कं) A dish of curds, ghee and honey, to be offered to a respectable guest on his arrival.  E. मधु honey, पृच् to sprinkle, aff. घञ् ।
मधुपर्णिका: मधुपर्णिका f. (-का) 	 1. The indigo plant. 	 2. A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 3. Moon plant, (Asclepias acida.) 	 4. A creeper of the Cryptogamia class, (Lycopodium imbricatum, Rox.) 	 5. A shrub, (Menispermum.) E. मधु honey, पर्ण a leaf, aff. कन्, fem. form; also मधुपर्णी ।
मधुपर्णी: मधुपर्णी f. (-र्णी) 	 1. A sort of creeper, (Menispermum glabrum.) 	 2. A tree, (Gmelina arborea.) 	 3. The indigo plant. 	 4. The sweet lime. E. मधु honey, पर्ण the leaf, aff. ङीष् ।
मधुपायिन्: मधुपायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Living on honey. 	 m. (-यी) A bee.  E. मधु honey, पा to drink, णिनि aff., and युक् augment.
मधुपालिका: मधुपालिका f. (-का) A tree, (Gmelina arborea.)  E. मधु honey, पाल् to nourish, वन् aff., fem. form. “गाम्भार्य्याम् ।”
मधुपुरी: मधुपुरी f. (-री) Mathurā, a city so called.  E. मधु the Rākshasa killed by SATRUGHNA, and पुरी a city or capital.
मधुपुष्प: मधुपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 	 1. A tree, (Bassia latifolia.) 	 2. The Mimosa Sirisha. 	 3. The Bakula tree, (Mimusops elengi.)  E. मधु wine or honey, and पुष्प flower.
मधुप्रमेह: मधुप्रमेह m. (-हः) Name of a particular disease of the urinary system.
मधुप्राशन: मधुप्राशन n. (-नं) One of the sixteen purificatory rites, consisting in putting a little honey into the month of a new-born child.
मधुप्रिय: मधुप्रिय m. (-यः) 	 1. A shrub, (Ardisia solanacea.) 	 2. A name of BALA-RĀMA.  E. मधु wine, &c., and प्रिय fond of.
मधुफल: मधुफल m. (-लः) 	 1. A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) 	 2. A sweet kind of cocoanut.  E. मधु honey, and फल fruit.
मधुफलिका: मधुफलिका f. (-का) A kind of date.
मधुभिद्: मधुभिद् m. (-भिद् or -भित् A name of KRISHṆA or VISHṆU.  E. मधु the Daitya; and भिद् destroyer.
मधुमक्षिका: मधुमक्षिका f. (-का) A bee.  E. मधु honey, and मक्षिका a fly.
मधुमत्: मधुमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Sweet, honied. 	 f. (-ती) A species of the Ushnih metre.  E. भधु and मतुप् aff.
मधुमथन: मधुमथन m. (-नः) A name of VISHṆU.  E. मधु the Daitya, and मथन destroyer.
मधुमय: मधुमय f. (-यः-यी-यं) Sweet, luscious.  E. मधु, and मयट् aff.
मधुमल्ली: मधुमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) Double jasmine.  E. मधु, and मल्ली jasmine. “मालतीपुष्पे ।”
मधुमस्तक: मधुमस्तक n. (-कं) A sweetmeat made of flour, honey, oil and ghee.  E. मधु honey, and मस्तक a head.
मधुमाधवी: मधुमाधवी f. (-वी) A kind of intoxicating drink.
मधुमाध्वीक: मधुमाध्वीक n. (-कं) A spirit distilled from the flowers of the Bassia latifolia.  E. मधु spirit, and माध्वीक the same prepared from honey.
मधुमूल: मधुमूल n. (-लं) An esculent root, a sort of yam.  E. मधु spirit, and मूल root. “मौआलु ।”
मधुयष्टि: मधुयष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Sugar-cane.  E. मधु honey, and यष्टि a cane or stick.
मधुयष्टिका: मधुयष्टिका f. (-का) Liquorice, (Glyeirrhiza glabra, or rather the Abrus precatorius, of which the root is similarly used.)  E. मधु honey, यष्टि a stick, and कन् added; or without the aff. मधुयष्टी f. (-ष्टी). “यष्टिमधु ।”

E. मधु honey, and रा to get or be, aff. क; to have the flavour of honey, to be as sweet.
मधुरक: मधुरक m. (-कः) A medicinal plant, commonly Jivaka.  E. मधुर the same, कन् added.
मधुरकण्टक: मधुरकण्टक m. (-कः) A sort of fish.  E. मधुर sweet, and कण्टक bone.
मधुरजम्बीर: मधुरजम्बीर m. (-रः) The sweet lime.  E. मधुर sweet, जम्बीर lime. “कम्लालेवु ।”
मधुरत्वच: मधुरत्वच m. (-चः) A shrub, (Orislea tomentosa.)  E. मधुर sweet, त्वच bark अच् added.
मधुरनिस्वना: मधुरनिस्वना f. (-ना) A woman with a sweet voice.  E. मधुर sweet, निस्वन who sounds.
मधुरवीजपूर: मधुरवीजपूर m. (-रः) The sweet lime.  E. मधुर sweet, वीजपूर a citron.
मधुरस: मधुरस m. (-सः) 	 1. Sweetness, (in flavour.) 	 2. Sweetness, (in speech.) 	 3. The sugar-cane. 	 4. The palm-tree. 	 f. (-सा) 	 1. A shrub, (San-seviera zeylanica.) 	 2. A plant, (Asclepias acida.) 	 3. Grapes.  E. मधु wine or honey, and रस juice, flavour.
मधुराचर: मधुराचर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sweet, mellifluous, mellow, melodious.  E. मधुर, and अक्षर letter.
मधुराम्लक: मधुराम्लक m. (-कः) The hog-plum, (Spondias mangifera.)  E. मधुर sweet, अम्ल sour, कन् aff.
मधुरालापा: मधुरालापा f. (-पा) The talking-Mainā, (Turdus Sālika.)  E. मधुर sweet, आलाप talking, fem. form.
मधुरिका: मधुरिका f. (-का) A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa, Rox.)  E. मधुरा the same, कन् aff.; this name is applied also to the Anethum pan-morium, Rox. and the Bengali derivative Mouri is applied to common anise.
मधुरिपु: मधुरिपु m. (-पुः) A name of KRISHṆA.  E. मधु the demon, and रिपु foe.
मधुरोदक: मधुरोदक m. (-कः) The sea of a fresh or sweet water, surrounding Pushkara dwīpa, and being the outermost of seven seas.  E. मधुर sweet, and उदक water.
मधुल: मधुल n. (-लं) Spirituous or vinous liquor.  E. मधु wine, ला to be or get, aff. क ।

मधुवीज: मधुवीज m. (-जः) The pomegranate.  E. मधु sweet, वीज seed.
मधुव्रत: मधुव्रत m. (-तः) A bee.  E. मधु honey, व्रत observance.
मधुशाख: मधुशाख m. (-खः) Bassia latifolia.  E. मधु spirituous liquor, शाखा a branch.

मधुश्रेणी: मधुश्रेणी f. (-णी) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)  E. मधु honey, श्वेणी a line or row. “मूर्वायाम् ।”

मधुसात्: मधुसात् Ind. As honey, sweet.  E. मधु and साति aff.
मधुसाद्भूत: मधुसाद्भूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Become sweet. E. (मधुसात्, and भूत become.
मधुसारथि: मधुसारथि m. (-थिः) KĀMA the Hindu CUPID.  E. मधु the spring personi-fied, and सारथि a charioteer, having Vasanta or spring for his coachman.
मधुसिक्थक: मधुसिक्थक m. (-कः) A sort of poison.  E. मधु honey, and सिक्थक wax.
मधुसुहृद्: मधुसुहृद् m. (-हृद् or -हृत्) KĀMADEVA.  E. मधु spring, सुहृत् the friend.
मधुसूदन: मधुसूदन m. (-नः) A name of VISHṆU. 	 f. (-नी) Bengal beet.  E. मधु the Daitya or honey, and सूदन destroyer.
मधुस्रवस्: मधुस्रवस् m. (-वाः) A tree, (Bassia latifolia).  E. मधु spirituous liquor, स्नु to drop or distil, aff. अमुन् ।
मधुस्रवा: मधुस्रवा f. (-वा) 	 1. A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) 	 2. Liquorice.  E. मधु honey, स्नु to drop, affs. अप् and टाप् ।
मधुस्वर: मधुस्वर m. (-रः) The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.  E. मधु sweet or spring, and स्वर note, song.
मधुहन्: मधुहन् m. (-हा) 	 1. A name of KRISHṆA. 	 2. A particular bird of prey. 3. A sooth-sayer.  E. मधु the Daitya, and हन् destroyer.
मधूच्छिष्ट: मधूच्छिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Bee's wax.  E. मध्रु honey and उच्छिष्ट left, rejected.
मधूपघ्न: मधूपघ्न n. (-घ्नं) The city Mathurā.  E. मधु the demon, उपघ्न destruction.
मधूलक: मधूलक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Sweet. 	 m. (-कः) 	 1. A sort of Bassia, grow-ing in watery or mountainous sites. 	 2. Sweetness. 	 f. (-लिका) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)  E. कन् added to the preceding.
मध्य: मध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 	 1. Middle, intermediate. 	 2. Right, proper, rea-sonable. 	 3. Low, vile. 	 4. Amongst, amidst. 	 5. Mean, middle, (in astronomy,) as मध्यच्छाया middle or mean shadow. 	 mn. (-ध्यः-ध्यं) 	 1. The interior. 	 2. Mean or common time in music. 	 3. The middle, the centre. 	 4. The waist. 	 5. The belly, abdomen. 	 6. Pause, internal. 7. The middle term of a progression. 	 f. (-ध्या) 	 1. A young woman, a girl arrived at puberty. 	 2. The middle-finger. 	 3. A form of metre, a stanza of four lines containing three syllables in each. 4. Of a middle size or quantity, moderate. 	 5. Neutral. 	 6. Just, reasonable. 	 m. (-ध्यः) Cessation, rest, interval. 	 n. (-ध्यं) 	 1. A very large number, ten thousand billions. 	 2. A horse's flank.  E. मा beauty, या to have, अण् aff., deriv. irr., or properly सन्-यत् aff. and ध substituted for the final.
मध्यग: मध्यग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Who or what goes in the centre or betwixt, amongst, &c.  E. मध्य and ग what goes.
मध्यगन्ध: मध्यगन्ध m. (-न्धः) The mango tree.  E. मध्य middle and गन्ध smell.
मध्यग्रहण: मध्यग्रहण n. (-णं) The middle of an eclipse.
मध्यचारिन्: मध्यचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Going amongst or amidst.  E. मध्य and चारिन् who goes.
मध्यतस्: मध्यतस् Ind. From or in the middle, centrical, centrically.  E. मध्य the middle, and तसिल् aff.
मध्यदिन: मध्यदिन n. (-नं) 	 1. Noon, midday. 	 2. The Bandhuka tree.
मध्यदीपक: मध्यदीपक n. (-कं) A species of the figure of speech called Dīpaka; in it the common term which throws light on the whole stanza is used in the middle.
मध्यदेश: मध्यदेश m. (-शः) 	 1. The middle region; part of India, bounded by Ku-ruksketra on the north, Allāhābād on the south, the Himālaya mountains on the east, and the Vindhya mountains on the west; comprising therefore the modern provinces of Allāhābād, Agrā, Delhi, Oudh, &c.; the northern limit is elsewhere defined to be the disappearance of the Saraswatī. 	 2. The middle part of any thing. 	 3. The waist. 	 4. The Belly. 	 5. The meridian.  E. मध्य middle, and देश country.
मध्यपदलोपिन्: मध्यपदलोपिन् m. (-पी) A compound word which omits the middle mem-ber in its composition.
मध्यम: मध्यम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 	 1. Middle, centrical, intervening, intermediate. 2. Middle-born, neither the oldest nor youngest. 	 3. Mean, (in astronomy,) as मध्यमगति mean motion, (of a planet.) 	 mn. (-मः-मं) The waist, the middle of the body. 	 m. (-मः) 	 1. One of the seven musical notes, the fourth note of the Hindu gamut. 	 2. The middle country: see मध्यदेश । 3. A sort of deer. 	 4. One of the Grāmas or musical scales of Hindus, corresponding apparently with the major made of European music. 	 f. (-मा) 	 1. A girl arrived at pu-berty, or in whom menstruation has commenced. 	 2. The middle finger. 	 3. A central blossom. 	 4. The pericarp of a lotus. 	 5. A woman in the middle of her youth considered as a character in poetic composition. 	 6. A form of metre, a verse of four lines of three syllables each.  E. मध्य middle, and म aff.
मध्यमपाण्डव: मध्यमपाण्डव m. (-वः) ARJUNA, the third or middle of the PĀṆḌU prin-ces.  E. मध्यम middle and पाण्डव, Pāndava or descendant of PĀNDU.
मध्यमपुरुष: मध्यमपुरुष m. (-षः) The second person, (in gram.)
मध्यमभृतक: मध्यमभृतक m. (-कः) A husbandman.  E. मध्यम middle, and भृतक a la-bourer; working partly for his own advantage, and partly for that of the landlord.
मध्यमलोक: मध्यमलोक m. (-कः) The earth, the world of mortals.  E. मध्यम middle, and लोक world; between heaven and hell.
मध्यमवयस्क: मध्यमवयस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Middle-aged.  E. मध्यम and वयस्क aged.
मध्यमसंग्रह: मध्यमसंग्रह m. (-हः) Intriguing with another man's wife, the act of presenting flowers, perfumes, &c. to her, and conversing with her privately.  E. मध्यम middle, संग्रह connection.
मध्यमसाहस: मध्यमसाहस m. (-सः) 	 1. Punishment due to crimes of a middling degree. 2. Injuring building, throwing down walls, &c.  E. मध्यम middle, साहस violence.
मध्यमाहरण: मध्यमाहरण n. (-णं) The elimination of the middle term in an equation, (in algebra.)
मध्यमिका: मध्यमिका f. (-का) A girl arrived at puberty, one in whom menstrua-tion has commenced.  E. मध्यमा, कन् added, in the fem. form.
मध्यमीय: मध्यमीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Central, middle.  E. मध्यम middle and छ aff.
मध्ययव: मध्ययव m. (-वः) A weight of six white mustard seeds.  E. मध्य middle, and यव barley-corn, the Yava being sometimes considered equal to eight seeds.
मध्यखत्र: मध्यखत्र m. (-त्रः) Midnight.  E. मध्य middle, रात्र night, and the mascu-line form in the compound.
मध्यरेखा: मध्यरेखा f. (-खा) The first meridian, (in astronomy.)
मध्यलोक: मध्यलोक m. (-कः) The earth, the dwelling of mortals.  E. मध्य middle, and लोक world; placed in the middle between heaven and hell; also with कन् added मध्यलोकक ।
मध्यलोकेश: मध्यलोकेश m. (-शः) A king, a sovereign.  E. मध्यलोक the earth, and ईश sovereign.
मध्यवत्तिन्: मध्यवत्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) 	 1. Central, middle. 	 2. Being amongst or amidst. 	 m. (-र्त्ती) A mediator.  E. मध्य and वर्त्तिन् who abides.
मध्यवृत्त: मध्यवृत्त n. (-त्तं) The navel.  E. मध्य the middle, and वृत्त abiding.
मध्यसूत्र: मध्यसूत्र n. (-त्रं) The central meridian, (in astronomy.)
मध्यस्थ: मध्यस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 	 1. Centrical, middle. 	 2. Neutral. 	 3. Mediat-ing. 	 m. (-स्थः) 	 1. A middle man, an umpire, an arbitrator, a mediator. 	 2. An epithet of ŚIVA.  E. मध्य middle, and स्थ what or who stays.
मध्यस्थता: मध्यस्थता f. (-ता) 	 1. Middle state or character. 	 2. Indifference.  E. मध्यस्थ middle, and तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व मध्यस्थत्व n. (-त्वं).
मध्यस्थल: मध्यस्थल n. (-लं) 	 1. The waist. 	 2. A middle place. 	 3. The centre.  E. मध्य middle, स्थल place or part.
मध्यस्थान: मध्यस्थान n. (-नं) 	 1. A Neutral soil. 	 2. A middle place.
मध्याह्न: मध्याह्न m. (-ह्नः) Mid-day, noon.  E. मध्य middle, अहन् a day.
मध्वल: मध्वल m. (-लः) Tippling, drinking, repeatedly.  E. मधु wine, अल् to be equal to, aff. अच् ।
मध्वापात: मध्वापात m. (-तः) Taste or touch of honey.  E. मधु and आपात alighting.
मध्वालुक: मध्वालुक n. (-कं) Sweet potato.  E. मधु sweet, आलु and esculent root, कन् added. “मौआलु ।”
मध्वासव: मध्वासव m. (-वः) A spirituous liquor, distilled from the blossoms of the Bassia latifolia.  E. मधु the Bassia, and आसव spirit.
मध्वासवनिक: मध्वासवनिक m. (-कः) A distiller.  E. मध्वासव spirit, नी to go, aff. क, form irr.
मन्: मन् r. 4th cl. (मन्यते) (उ) मनु r. 8th cl. (मनुते) 	 1. To know, to under-stand. 	 2. To regard, to mind. 	 3. To think, to conceive. r. 10th cl. (मानयते) 	 1. To be dull or insensible. 	 2. To be proud. 	 3. To oppose, to stop. r. 1st and 10th cls. (मनति मानयति) To honour, to respect, to worship. With अनु prefixed, To assent to, to agree. With अभि. To desire. With अव, To disrespect. With सम To concur, to agree.
मन: मन n. (-नं) Indian spikenard.  E. मन् to respect, aff. अच् । “जटामांस्याम् ।”
मनआप: मनआप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Pleasing, agreeable, beautiful.  E. मनस् the mind, आप् to go or attract, aff. अण्; the final consonant of the first word is rejected, and the vowels do not coalesce.
मनःकृत: मनःकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Attended to, applying the mind.  E. मनस् and कृत made.
मनःशिल: मनःशिल mf. (-लः-ला) Red arsenic.  E. मन्स् the mind, शिला a stone; mineral delightful to the mind or heart; also with the dental स, मनःसिल । “मन्छाल ।”
मनःसिल: मनःसिल mf. (-लः-ला) Red arsenic: see the last.
मनन: मनन n. (-नं) Minding, understanding.  E. मन् to know, aff. ल्युट् ।
मनस्: मनस् n. (-नः) 	 1. The mind, considered as the seat of perception and passion, the heart. 	 2. The intellect, the understanding. 	 3. The con-necting link between the Indriyas and Buddhi, (in Nyāya Phil.) 4. Thought, imagination, conception, fancy. 	 5. Intention, de-sign, purpose, wish. 	 6. Desire, affection. 	 7. Disposition, temper. 8. Energy, spirit. 	 9. Conscience. 	 10. Red arsenic. 	 11. An epithet of the lake Mānasa.  E. मन् to know, to understand, aff. असुन् ।
मनसा: मनसा f. (-सा) The goddess of the serpent race, and the particular pro-tectress against their venom.  E. मनस् the mind, aff. टाप्; the object of love, and devotion.
मनसाज्ञायिन्: मनसाज्ञायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Knowing by the mind, perceiving in-tellectually.  E. मनसा third case of मनस् and ज्ञायिन् who knows.
मनसादेवी: मनसादेवी f. (-वी) The goddess presiding over snakes: see the last. E. मनसा the same, and देवी goddess.
मनसिज: मनसिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Mental, intellectual. 	 m. (-जः) A name of KĀMA or love.  E. मनसि in the heart or mind, and ज born.
मनसिशय: मनसिशय m. (-यः) KĀMA or love.  E. मनसि in the heart or mind, and शय who reposes.
मनस्क: मनस्क mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं) Mental.  E. मनस् and कन् aff.
मनस्कार: मनस्कार m. (-रः) The attention of the mind to its own sensations, con-sciousness of pleasure or pain.  E. मनस् of the mind and कार opera-tion; the compound also occurs with the seventh case मनसिकार ।
मनस्ताप: मनस्ताप m. (-पः) Mental distress.  E. मनस् and त्राप sorrow.
मनस्ताल: मनस्ताल m. (-लः) The lion of DURGĀ.  E. मनस् the mind, तल् to depress, aff. घञ् ।
मनस्विता: मनस्विता f. (-ता) 	 1. Hope, expectation, dependance. 	 2. Intelligence. E. मनस्विन् and तल् aff.
मनस्विन्: मनस्विन् mfn. (-स्वी-स्विनी-स्वि) 	 1. Attentive, fixing the mind upon any thing. 	 2. Intelligence, intellectual. 	 f. (-स्विनी) A virtuous wife. E. मनस् the mind or heart, aff. विन् ।
मनाक्: मनाक् Ind. 	 1. A little. 	 2. Tardily, slowly.  E. मन् to know, आक् aff.
मनाका: मनाका f. (-का) A female elephant.  E. मन् to mind, &c. Unādi aff. आक ।
मनाक्कर: मनाक्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Doing little, lazy, sluggish. 	 f. (-रा) A sort of Agallochum.  E. मनाक् a little, and कर who does.
मनायी: मनायी f. (-यी) The wife of MANU.  E. मनु the saint, ङीष् aff., and उ changed to ऐ; otherwise मनावी the same.
मनित: मनित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Known, understood.  E. मन् to know, aff. क्त ।
मनीक: मनीक n. (-कं) Collyrium, powdered antimony or other substances, used as an application and ornament to the eye.  E. मन् to know, to be agreeable, ईकन् Unādi aff.
मनीषा: मनीषा f. (-षा) 	 1. Intellect, understanding. 	 2. Desire, wish.  E. मनस् the mind, ईष् to go, aff. क, or ईष aff., form irr.
मनीषिन्: मनीषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Intellectual, intelligent. 	 m. (-षी) A Pandit, a learned Brāhman, a teacher.  E. मनीषा understanding, इनि poss-essive aff.
मनु: मनु m. (-नुः) 	 1. MANU, the legislator and saint, the son of BRAHMĀ, or a personification of BRAHMĀ himself, the creator of the world and progenitor of mankind; the name is however a generic term. and in every Kalpa or interval from creation to creation, there are fourteen successive MANUS presiding over the universe for the period of a Manwantara, respectively; in the present crea-tion there have been the six following MANUS: MARĪCHĪ or SWAYAMBHUVA, the supposed revealer of the code of law possessed by the Hindus, SWĀROCHISHA, OUTTAMĪ, TĀMASA, RAIVATA, and CHĀKSHUSHA; the seventh or the present MANU is VAIVASWATA, and is regarded to be the founder of the solar race of kings; SĀBARNĪ, DAKSHA-SĀBARNĪ, BRAHMA-SĀBARNĪ, DHARMA-SĀ-BARNĪ, RUDRASĀBARNĪ, DEVA-SĀBARNĪ, and INDRA-SĀVARNĪ, these seven Manus are to come in the present creation. 	 2. A man in general. 	 3. One of the Jaina saints. 	 4. A Mantra, a mystical verse or formula. 	 5. The number fourteen. 	 f. (-नुः-नायी-नावी) The wife of a legislator or MANU.  E. मन् to know or under-stand, (the Vedas or scripture especially,) and उ Unādi aff.
मनुज: मनुज m. (-जः) A man in general. 	 f. (-जा) A woman.  E. मनु the legis-lator and progenitor of mankind, and ज born, descended.
मनुजेन्द्र: मनुजेन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) A king.  E. मनुज and इन्द्र chief.
मनुभू: मनुभू m. (-भूः) Man, a man, mankind.  E. मनु the saint, and भू born: see मनुज ।
मनुराज्: मनुराज् m. (-राट्) KUVERA, the god of wealth.  E. मनु man, and राज् to shine, aff. क्किप् ।
मनुषी: मनुषी f. (-षी) A woman, the wife or female of the man.  E. मनुष्य a man, and ङीष् aff.
मनुष्य: मनुष्य m. (-ष्यः) Man, a man, mankind.  E. मनु the progenitor of man-kind, यत् aff. of descent, and युक् augment.
मनुष्यत्व: मनुष्यत्व n. (-त्वं) The state or condition of man, manhood, humanity. E. त्व added to मनुष्य; also with तल्, मनुष्यता ।
मनुष्यधर्मन्: मनुष्यधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) KUVERA, the god of wealth. 	 n. (-र्म्म) The duty of man.  E. मनुष्य man, and धर्म्मन् piety.
मनुष्यधर्म्मन्: मनुष्यधर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) KUVERA, the god of wealth. 	 n. (-र्म्म) The duty of man.  E. मनुष्य man, and धर्म्मन् piety.
मनुष्ययज्ञ: मनुष्ययज्ञ m. (-ज्ञः) Hospitality, (one of the five daily acts of piety.) E. मनुष्य a man, and यज्ञ sacrifice, sacrament.
मनुष्यसभा: मनुष्यसभा f. (-भा) 	 1. A multitude, a crowd, a meeting. 	 2. A place of meeting or assembly.  E. मनुष्य a man, mankind, and सभा assembly.
मनोगत: मनोगत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Seated in the mind. 	 n. (-तं) Thoughts, ideas, notions, feelings.  E. मनस् and गत gone to or in.
मनोगवी: मनोगवी f. (-वी) Wish, desire.  E. मनस् the mind, and गो a cow, &c. fem. form.
मनोगुप्त: मनोगुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Thought or meditated on secretly. 	 f. (-प्ता) Red arsenic.  E. मनस् and गुप्त cherished.
मनोज: मनोज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or seated in the mind. 	 m. (-जः) KĀMA. E. मनस् and ज born.
मनोजन्मन्: मनोजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Born or seated in the mind. 	 m. (-न्मा) KĀMA or CUPID.  E. मनस् the heart or mind, and जन्मन् birth; also मनोज ।
मनोजव: मनोजव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 	 1. Fatherly, parental. 	 2. Quick in thought or apprehension. 	 3. Swift, as thought. 	 f. (-वा) A plant: see अग्निजिह्वा. n. (-वं) Quickness of thought or apprehension.  E. मनस् the mind, जु to move, to pervade, aff. अच्; or मनस् compounded with जव speed.
मनोजवस: मनोजवस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Fatherly.  E. मनोज desire, love, वस् to abide, aff. अच् ।
मनोज्ञ: मनोज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Beautiful, handsome, lovely, pleasing, agree-able. 	 f. (-ज्ञा) 	 1. Red arsenic. 	 2. Intoxicating liquor. 	 3. The daughter of a sovereign, a princess.  E. मनस् the mind or heart, ज्ञा to know, to get, aff. क ।
मनोदण्ड: मनोदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) Restraint or control over the mind.  E. मनस् and दण्ड castigation.
मनीनीत: मनीनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Chosen, preferred.  E. मनस् and नीत taken.
मनोभव: मनोभव m. (-वः) KĀMA or CUPID.  E. मनस् the mind or heart, and भव born.
मनोभू: मनोभू m. (-भूः) KĀMADEVA.  E. मनस् the heart, भू born.
मनोमयकोश: मनोमयकोश m. (-शः) The second of the five sheaths in which the soul is encased, (in Vedanta Phil.)

ममता: ममता f. (-ता) 	 1. Pride, arrogance, self-sufficiency. 	 2. The interest or affection entertained for other objects from considering them as belonging to or connected with one's self. 	 3. Individuality.  E. मम mine, the possessive case of अस्मद्, and तल् aff. of the abstract; also with त्व aff. ममत्व ।

मय्: मय् r. 1st cl. (मयते) To go, to move.
मय: मय m. (-यः) 	 1. A camel. 	 2. A mule. 	 3. A demon, and the carpenter or architect of the DAITYAS. 	 4. Hurting, injuring. 	 f. (-या) Adminis-tering remedies, the practice of physic. 	 f. (-यी) Used as and affix in the sense of “consisting of” “Made of” Full of.  E. मय् to go, or मि to scatter, or मी to hurt, affs. अच or खल् and टाप् ।

मयु: मयु m. (-युः) 	 1. A KINNARA or chorister of Swarga, 2. A deer.  E. मि to scatter, (sweet sounds, &c.) Unādi aff. उ ।
मयुराज: मयुराज m. (-जः) A name of KUVERA.  E. मयु KINNARA, and राज chief; having these beings attached especially to his court and capital.

मस्तकस्नेह: मस्तकस्नेह m. (-हः) The brain.  E. मस्तक the head, and स्नेह marrow.
मस्तकाख्य: मस्तकाख्य m. (-ख्यः) The top of a tree.  E. मस्तक, आख्या appellation.
मस्ति: मस्ति f. (-स्तिः) Weighing, measuring.  E. मस् to weigh, क्तिन् aff.
मस्तिष्क: मस्तिष्क m. (-ष्कः) The brain.  E. मस्-क्तिन् मस्तिं परिणति भेदं मुष्कति मुष्क गतौ अच् पृषो० ।
मस्तिष्कत्वच्: मस्तिष्कत्वच् f. (-त्वक्) The membrance surrounding the brain.
मस्तु: मस्तु n. (-स्तुः) 	 1. The watery part of curds, the whey. 	 2. Sour cream. E. मस् to weigh, Unādi aff. तुन् ।
मस्तुलुङ्ग: मस्तुलुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) The brain; it also occurs मस्तुलुङ्गक ।
मह्: मह् r. 1st and 10th cls. (महति महयति-ते) To revere, to worship, to adore. (इ)महि r. 1st cl. (मंहते) To grow or increase. r. 10th cl. (मंहयति) 	 1. To speak. 	 2. To shine.
मह: मह m. (-हः) 	 1. A festival. 	 2. Light, lustre. 	 3. A buffalo. 	 4. Sacrifice, oblation. 	 f. (-हा) 	 1. A cow. 	 2. A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioi-des.)  E. मह् to worship, aff. घञ्: see महस and महि ।
महक: महक m. (-कः) 	 1. An excellent man. 	 2. A tortoise. 	 3. A name of VISHṆU.  E. मह् to worship, वुन् aff.
महत्: महत् mfn. (-हान्-हती-हत्) 	 1. Great, large, bulky. 	 2. Much, many. 	 3. Best, excellent, illustrious. 	 4. Loud. 	 5. Far advanced. 	 6. Long. 	 7. Intense. 	 8. Important. 	 9. Eminent, high. 	 10. Dense, thick. 	 11. Numerous. 	 n. (-त्) 	 1. Kingdom, dominion. 	 2. The intellectual principle, the second principle in creation. 	 3. Sacred knowledge. 4. Infinity, greatness. Adv. Much, very, exceeding. 	 f. (-ती) The Vinā or lute of NĀRADA, containing seven or one hundred strings. 	 2. The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) 	 m. (-हान्) 	 1. The second of the twenty five principles of creation according to Sānkhya philosophy. 	 2. A camel. 	 3. An epithet of Rudra.  E. मह् to worship, अति Unādi aff. In composition महा is generally substi-tuted, आ being inserted in place of the final.
महत्तर: महत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Greater, more. 	 m. (-रः) 	 1. A man of the fourth or servile tribe, a Sūdra. 	 2. The headman of a village. 	 3. A courtier.  E. महत् great, and तरप् aff. of comparison, perhaps in derision, or in comparison with the mixed tribes.
महत्त्व: महत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) Greatness, either in bulk or rank.  E. महत् great, त्व aff. of the abstract.
महदाश्चर्य्य: महदाश्चर्य्य n. Adv. (-र्य्यं) Very surprising.  E. महत् and आश्वर्य्य surprising.
महदाश्रय: महदाश्रय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dependent upon or attached to the great. E. महत् and आश्रय asylum.
महद्विल: महद्विल n. (-लं) Æther, heaven, Akās.  E. महत् great and विल a variety.
महन्त: महन्त m. (-न्तः) The head of a monastery.
महर्लोक: महर्लोक m. (-कः) A division of the universe; a region said to be one Crore or Yojanas above the polar star, and to be the abode of those saints who survive a destruction of the world.  E. महस् sa-crifice, लोक world.
महर्षि: महर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛshi or saint of a particular order, including VYĀSA and others.  E. मह for महत् great, and ऋषि saint: see राजर्षि ।
महल्लक: महल्लक m. (-कः) An eunuch employed in a Hārem. 	 2. A large house. 	 f. (-ल्लिका) Feeble.  E. महल्ल said to mean the inner apart-ments, probably an Arabic word, and कन् added: otherwise with ठक् added महल्लिक m. (-कः) ।
महस्: महस् n. (-हः) 	 1. A festival, a sacred festival. 	 2. Light, lustre. 	 3. Greatness, vigour. 	 4. Sacrifice, oblation.  E. मह to worship, aff. असुन् ।
महस: महस n. (-सं) 	 1. Knowledge. 	 2. Kind, sort, difference.  E. मह् to worship, Unādi aff. असच् ।
महाकच्छ: महाकच्छ m. (-च्छः) 	 1. The ocean. 	 2. The deity of the ocean VARUṆA. 	 3. A mountain.  E. महा great, and कच्छ a shore or bank.
महाकण्टकिनी: महाकण्टकिनी f. (-नी) The Indian prickly pear, (Cactus Indicus.)  E. महा great, कण्टक a thorn, इनि and ङीष् affs. “फणिमन्सा ।”
महाकन्द: महाकन्द m. (-न्दः) 	 1. Garlic. 	 2. A very large esculent root, a sort of yam. 	 3. A plant, (Hingtsha repens.)  E. महा great and कन्द root.
महाकपर्द: महाकपर्द m. (-र्दः) A species of shell.
महाकपित्थ: महाकपित्थ m. (-त्थः) 	 1. A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) 	 2. Red garlic.  E. महा great, and कपित्थ wood-apple.
महाकर: महाकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 	 1. Large-handed, &c. 	 2. Having a large revenue. 	 m. (-रः) A large hand, rent, &c.  E. महा, and कर a hand.
महाकर्णिकार: महाकर्णिकार m. (-रः) A plant, (cassia fistula.) आरग्वधे “स्ॐँदाल्” इति भाषा ।
महाकला: महाकला f. (-ला) The night of the new moon.
महाकवि: महाकवि m. (-विः) 	 1. An epithet of Sūkra. 	 2. A classical poet.
महाकाय: महाकाय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Large, bulky, stout. 	 m. (-यः) 	 1. A name of NANDĪ, the door-keeper and attendant of ŚIVA. 	 2. An elephant. E. महा large and काय body.
महाकाल: महाकाल m. (-लः) 	 1. A name or rather a form of ŚIVA, in his character of the destroying deity, being then represented of a black colour, and of aspect more or less terrific. 	 2. A name of NANDĪ, ŚIVA'S porter and attendant. 	 3. The mango tree. 	 f. (-ली) 	 1. The wife of the preceding deity, and a terrific form of DURGĀ. 	 2. A goddess pecu-liar to the Jainas. 	 3. One of the Vidyā-devis of the same sect. E. महा great, excessively, काल black, or time; in one capacity that of जगद्भक्षकः the world-eater, ŚIVA or MAHĀKĀLA may be considered as a personification of time that destroys all things.
महाकाव्य: महाकाव्य n. (-व्यं) A regular and classical poem.  E. महा great, and काव्य a poem; the title is applied especially to five works; the Kumāra Sambhava, and Raghu Vaṃśa of KALIDĀSA; the Kirātārjuniya of BHĀRABĪ; the Naisadha of SRIHARSHA, and the Sisupāla Badham of MĀGHA.
मलाकुल: मलाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Eminent by birth, of good family or extrac-tion.  E. महा great, and कुल lineage.
महाकुलीन: महाकुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of good family.  E. महा great, and कुलीन of family.
महाकूप: महाकूप m. (-पः) A large or deep well.  E. महा great, and कूप a well.
महाकूल: महाकूल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a good family. E. See महाकुल ।
महाक्षीर: महाक्षीर m. (-रः) Sugar-cane.  E. महा great, and क्षीर milk.
महाग: महाग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Great, prosperous.  E. महा and ग who goes.
महागद: महागद m. (-दः) Fever.  E. महा and गद sickness.
महागन्ध: महागन्ध m. (-न्धः) A sort of cane growing near water, (Calamus fasci-culatus, Rox.) 	 f. (-न्धा) A name or form of DURGA. 	 n. (-न्धं) Gum myrrh. 	 2. A kind of Sandal-wood.  E. महा great, and गन्ध smell.
महागिरि: महागिरि m. (-रिः) 	 1. Any large mountain. 	 2. A sacred personage pe-culiar to the Jainas.  E. महा great and गिरि a mountain.
महाग्रीव: महाग्रीव m. (-वः) A camel.  E. महा great, and ग्रीवा a neck.
महाग्रीविन्: महाग्रीविन् m. (-वी) A camel.  E. महा large, ग्रीवा neck, इनि aff.
महाघास: महाघास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Abounding with grass or fodder.  E. महा, घास grass.
महाघूर्णा: महाघूर्णा f. (-र्णा) Spirituous or vinous liquor.  E. महा great, much, घूर्ण to roll, affs. अच् and टाप् ।
महाघोर: महाघोर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Very formidable, terrific, horrible. 	 m. (-रः) A division of Tartarus or hell.  E. महा great, much, and घोर terrific.
महाघोष: महाघोष m. (-षः) A great noise, a loud sound. 	 n. (-षं) A market, a fair. f. (-षा) 	 1. A plant, commonly called Karkatasringi or Crab's horn described as a climbing and milky plant, and supposed to be the Asclepias geminata. 	 2. Gum olibanum tree.  E. महा great, घोष sound, &c.
महाङ्ग: महाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Bulky, big, large-bodied. 	 m. (-ङ्गः) 	 1. A camel. 2. A kind of rat. 	 3. An epithet of ŚIVA.  E. महा great, अङ्ग body. “गोक्षुरक्षुपे, रक्तचित्रकक्षुपे च ।”
महाचण्ड: महाचण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 	 1. One of YAMA'S attendants. 	 2. A very violent or passionate man.  E. महा great, much, चण्ड hot, passionate.
महाज: महाज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Illustrious, high-born. 	 m. (-जः) A large goat. E. महा great, and अज a goat, or ज born.
महाजन: महाजन m. (-नः) 	 1. A virtuous or illustrious man, a great man. 	 2. A merchant, a trader. 	 3. The mob.  E. महा great, जन a man.
महाजम्बू: महाजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) A plant, perhaps a kind of Eugenia.  E. महा great, and जम्बू the rose-apple.
महाजातीय: महाजातीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Of an excellent sort or species.  E. महा great, जातीय of a species.
महाजाली: महाजाली f. (-ली) A plant, a sort of Ghosa, with yellow flowers.  E. महा great, जाल a net.
महाज्वाल: महाज्वाल m. (-लः) Sacrificial fire. 	 f. (-ला) One of the Vidyā-devīs or goddesses peculiar to the Jainas.  E. महा great, ज्वाल flame, lustre.
महातमप्रभा: महातमप्रभा f. (-भा) The lowermost division of Naraka or hell.  E. महा great, तम darkness, and प्रभा flame.
महातरु: महातरु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Euphorbia of various kinds.)  E. महा large, and तरु a tree. “स्नुहीवृक्षे” “मन्सा गाछ” इति भाषा ।
महातल: महातल n. (-लं) The fifth in descent of the seven Pātālas or regions under the earth, inhabited by various races of evil beings, as the Nāgas, Asuras, Daityas, &c.  E. महा great, and तल depth.
महातारा: महातारा f. (-रा) A goddess of the Bauddhas.
महातिक्त: महातिक्त mfn. (-क्त्रः-क्ता-क्तं) Very bitter. 	 m. (-क्तः) The large Nimba tree, (Melia sempervirens.) 	 f. (-क्ता) A plant, commonly Ākanādi. E. महा much, and तिक्त bitter. यवतिक्तायांच “तित्पल्ता” इति भाषा ।
महातीक्ष्ण: महातीक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) Very sharp, (as flavour,) or literally, (as a weapon,) or figuratively, (as perception, &c.) 	 f. (-क्ष्णा) The mark-ing-nut plant.  E. महा great or much, तीक्ष्ण sharp, acrid, acute.
महातेजस्: महातेजस् mfn. (-जाः-जाः-जः) 	 1. Very bright. 	 2. Very energetic or vigor-ous. 	 m. (-जाः) 	 1. A name of KĀRTIKEYA. 	 2. AGNI, the deity of fire. 	 3. A hero, a demi-god. 	 n. (-क्ष्णं) Quicksilver.  E. महा great, and तेजस् light or glory, &c.
महात्मन्: महात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Liberal, lofty-minded, magnanimous.  E. महा great, आत्मन् self, soul.
महादन्त: महादन्त m. (-न्तः) 	 1. An elephant with large tusks. 	 2. An elephant's tusk.  E. महा great, and दन्त tooth.
महादश: महादश f. (-शां) The influence of a predominant planet.
महादारु: महादारु m. (-रुः) A sort of pine, (P. Devadāru.)  E. महा large, and दारु wood.
महादुन्दु: महादुन्दु m. (-न्दुः) A large military drum.  E. महा great, दुन्दु a drum.
महादेव: महादेव m. (-वः) ŚIVA. 	 f. (-वी) DURGĀ the wife of ŚIVA.  E. महा great, and देव god; the epithet Mahā compounded with a substantive forms many appellatives of these deities especially; thus ŚIVA is Mahākāla, Mahārūdra, Maheśwara, &c. and DURGĀ is named Mahāvidya, Mahāsmriti, Mahāmedha, Mahāmoha, &c. &c.
महाद्रुम: महाद्रुम m. (-मः) The holy fig-tree, (Ficus religiosa.)  E. महा great, and द्रुम a tree.
महाधन: महाधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Rich, opulent. 	 2. Costly, precious, valuable. n. (-नं) 	 1. Any thing costly or precious. 	 2. Gold. 	 3. Incense. 	 4. Costly raiment. 	 5. Agriculture.  E. महा great, धन wealth or price.
महाधातु: महाधातु m. (-तुः) Gold.  E. महा great, chief, and धातु mineral.
महानट: महानट m. (-टः) ŚIVA.  E. महा great, and नट a dancer.
महानन्द: महानन्द m. (-न्दः) Eternal emancipation or beatitude. 	 f. (-न्दा) 	 1. Wine. 2. Name of a particular river.  E. महा great, आनन्द happiness.
महानरक: महानरक n. (-कं) One of the twenty-one hells or divisions of Tartarus. E. महा and नरक hell.
महानल: महानल m. (-लः) A kind of reed. “देवनले ।”
महानवमी: महानवमी f. (-मी) The ninth day of the first half of Āshwina sacred to DURGĀ.
महानस: महानस mn. (-सः-सं) A kitchen. 	 n. (-सं) A heavy carriage.  E. महा great, chief, अनस rice or food, टच् added; to which the food is conveyed to be dressed, &c.
महानाद: महानाद m. (-दः) 	 1. A large black rainy cloud. 	 2. A loud sound. 	 3. An elephant. 	 4. A lion. 	 5. The ear. 	 6. A camel. 	 7. A conch-shell. n. (-दं) A musical instrument.  E. महा great and नाद noise or sound.
महानिद्रा: महानिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Death, dying.  E. महा great, निद्रा sleep.
महानिम्ब: महानिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A large kind of Nimba tree, (Melia sempervirens.) E. महा great, and निम्ब the Nimba. “घोडानिम् ।”
महानिशा: महानिशा f. (-शा) Midnight.  E. महा great, and निशा night.
महानीच: महानीच m. (-चः) A washerman.  E. महा great, much, and नीच vile.
महानील: महानील m. (-लः) 	 1. The emerald. 	 2. One of the Nāgas. 	 3. A plant, (Verbesina scandens, Rox.)  E. महा great, and नील blue.
महानुभाव: महानुभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Magnanimous, liberal. 	 m. (-वः) A gentleman. E. महा great, अनुभाव disposition.
महापक्ष: महापक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. A sort of duck. 	 2. An epithet of GARUḌA. 	 f. (-क्षी) An owl.  E. महा large, and पक्ष a side, a wing.
महापञ्चमूलक: महापञ्चमूलक n. (-कं) The great five roots; they are as follows:--“विल्वोऽग्निमन्थः श्योनाकः काश्मर्य्यः पाटलातथा । सर्वैस्तु मिलितैरेतैः स्यान्महापञ्चमूलकम् ॥”
महापञ्चविष: महापञ्चविष n. (-षं) The five great poisons; they are as follows:--“शृङ्गी च कालकूटश्च मुस्तको वत्सनाभकः । शक्तुकश्चेति योगोऽयं महापञ्चविषाभिधः ॥”
महापत्र: महापत्र m. (-त्रः) A potherb. “मालाकन्दे” f. (-त्रा) A kind of Eugenia. “महाजम्बूवृक्षे” ।  E. महा large, पत्र a leaf.
महापथ: महापथ m. (-थः) 	 1. The principal path or entrance to a town or house. &c., a main road, a highway. 	 2. The end of life, the way of all flesh. 	 3. Name of certain precipices from which people used to throw themselves to obtain entrance into heaven.  E. महा chief, पथ road.
महापथगम: महापथगम m. (-मः) Dying.  E. महापथ the great way, (by which all mortals travel,) गम going.
महापद्म: महापद्म m. (-द्मः) 	 1. One of the principal Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla. 2. One of KUVERA'S Nidhis or treasures. 	 3. A large number, one hundred thousand millions. 	 4. A Kinnara or attendant on KUVE-RA. 	 n. (-द्मं) The large white lotus.  E. महा great, and पद्म a lotus.
महापातक: महापातक n. (-कं) 	 1. A crime of the highest degree, as killing a Brāh-mana, stealing gold from a priest, drinking spirits, adultery with the wife of a spiritual teacher, and associating with persons who have committed these offences. 	 2. Great crime in general.  E. महा great, पातक offence: see पञ्चमहापातक ।
महापातकिन्: महापातकिन् m. (-की) An offender in the highest degree: see the last. E. महापातक great sin, and इनि aff.
महापाप: महापाप n. (-पं) 	 1. A sin of the highest kind. see महापातक. 	 2. Heinous crime, or sin in general.  E. महा excessive, and पाप sin.
महापुरुष: महापुरुष m. (-षः) A great man.  E. महा and पुरुष a man.
महाप्रभ: महाप्रभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Very bright, splendid. 	 m. (-भः) Lamp-light, the light of a lamp.  E. महा much, प्रभा shining.
महाप्रभु: महाप्रभु m. (-भुः) 	 1. A holy man, a saint. 	 2. A king. 	 3. INDRA. 	 4. ŚIVA. E. महा chief, and प्रभु master.
महाप्रलय: महाप्रलय m. (-यः) 	 1. A destruction of the world, occuring after every period of 4,320,000,000 years. 	 2. A total destruction of the uni-verse, happening after a period commensurate with the life of BRAHMĀ, or 100 years, each day of which is equal to the period first stated, and each night of which is of similar duration; at the expiration of this term, the seven Lokas, with the saints, gods, and BRAHMĀ himself, are annihilated.  E. महा great, प्रलय destruction.
महाप्राण: महाप्राण m. (-णः) 	 1. A raven. 	 2. The aspirate utterance of the aspirated letters.
महाफल: महाफल m. (-लः) A particular fruit-tree, (Agle marmelos.) 	 f. (-ला) 	 1. A bitter gourd: see इन्द्रवारुणी. 	 2. A kind of spear.  E. महा and फल fruit.
महाफेणा: महाफेणा f. (-णा) Cuttle-fish-bone.  E. महा great, and फेण froth, foam.

महिन्धक: महिन्धक m. (-कः) 	 1. A rat. 	 2. An ichneumon. 	 3. The string of a pole for carrying loads.

महिला: महिला f. (-ला) 	 1. A woman, a female. 	 2. A woman literally or figura-tively intoxicated. 	 3. A plant bearing a fragrant seed, commonly Priyangu. 	 4. A perfume commonly Reṇukā.  E. मह् to worship or be worshipped, Unādi aff. इलच्; also महला and महेला ।

महिष: महिष m. (-षः) 	 1. A buffalo. 	 2. The emblem of one of the Jaina saints. 3. The emblem and vehicle of YAMA. 	 4. The name of an Asura or demon slain by DURGĀ. 	 f. (-षी) 	 1. महिषमर्दिनी: महिषमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ.  E. महिष the ASURA so named, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.
महिषमर्द्दिनी: महिषमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) The goddess DURGĀ.  E. महिष the ASURA so named, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.
महिषवाहन: महिषवाहन m. (-नः) YAMA, the PLUTO of the Hindus.  E. महिष a buffalo, वाहन vehicle.
महिषाक्ष: महिषाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A plant, supposed to be the Bdellium tree.  E. महिष a buffalo, and अक्ष eye. “गुग्गुलभेदे, भगन्दररोगे च ।”

महीज: महीज m. (-जः) 	 1. The planet MARS. 	 2. A tree. 	 n. (-जं) Wet ginger.

महीधर: महीधर m. (-रः) A mountain.  E. मही and धर what holds.

महीभर्तृ: महीभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A king.  E. मही, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.
महीभर्त्तृ: महीभर्त्तृ m. (-र्त्ता) A king.  E. मही, and भर्त्तृ who cherishes.
महीभुज्: महीभुज् m. (-भुक्) A king.  E. मही and भुज् who possesses.
महीमय: महीमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Earthen, made of earth or clay.  E. मही earth, मयट् aff.

महेन्द्राणी: महेन्द्राणी f. (-णी) The wife of INDRA.  E. महा great, and इन्द्राणी the same.
महेरणा: महेरणा f. (-णा) The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia, thurifera.)  E. महा great, ईरण diffusion; or मह sacrifice, ईर् to go to, to be used in, aff. ल्यु; also महेरुणा । “शल्लकीवृक्षे ।”
महेला: महेला f. (-ला) A woman.  E. मह a festival, इला the earth or site; or मह् to worship, इलच् Unādi aff., and the vowel irregularly changed.
महेलिका: महेलिका f. (-का) A woman.  E. कन् added to the last.
महेश: महेश m. (-शः) ŚIVA.  E. मह great, ईश lord or god.
महेशबन्धु: महेशबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.)  E. महेश ŚIVA, and बन्धु friend.
महेश्वर: महेश्वर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. 	 f. (-री) 	 1. DURGĀ the wife of ŚIVA. 	 2. Mixed or bell-metal. 	 3. A flower, (Clitoria ternata.)  E. महा great, and ईश्वर God, fem. aff. ङीष् ।
महेश्वरकरच्युता: महेश्वरकरच्युता f. (-ता) The Kharatoya river in the north of Bengal. E. महेश्वर ŚIVA, कर the hand and च्युत fallen.
महेषु: महेषु f. (-षुः) A large arrow.  E. महा and इषु an arrow.
महेष्वास: महेष्वास m. (-सः) A warrior, a champion, an archer.  E. महेषु, and आस who shoots.
महोक्ष: महोक्ष m. (-क्षः) A large bull or ox.  E. महा large, उक्षन् an ox, टच् aff.

महोत्पल: महोत्पल n. (-लं) 	 1. A lotus, (Nymphæa nelumbo.) 	 2. The Sārasa or Indian crane.  E. महा large, chief, and उत्पल a water-lily.
महोत्सव: महोत्सव m. (-वः) 	 1. A great festival. 	 2. KĀMA.  E. महा, and उत्सव a festival.

महोदधि: महोदधि m. (-धिः) 	 1. The ocean. 	 2. INDRA.  E. महा great, उदधि the sea.

महौषधि: महौषधि f. (-धिः) 	 1. A sort of grass, commonly Durbā. 	 2. A kind of sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) “लज्जावती लता”  E. महा large and औषधि a deciduous plant.

मांसपिटक: मांसपिटक mn. (-कः-कं) A basket of flesh.
मांसपेशी: मांसपेशी f. (-शी) 	 1. A muscle. 	 2. The fetus during its early formation.

माकलि: माकलि m. (-लिः) 	 1. The charioteer of INDRA. 	 2. The moon.
माक्ष्: माक्ष् (इ) माक्षि r. 1st cl. (माङ्क्षति) To desire.

A bard, a minstrel, whose duty it is, to recite the praises of sovereigns, their genealogy, and the deeds of their ancestors, in their presence; and to attend on the march of an army, and animate the soldiers by martial songs: the minstrel forms a particular caste, said to spring from a Vaisya father, and Kshetriya mother; in mythology, they are said to have been created at once by the will of ŚIVA; under the name of Bhauts, they are still numerous in the west of Inda where they are a privileged tribe. 	 2. A month, the twelfth part of the Hindu year; it is usually a lunar one, consisting of thirty Tithis, but it may be a Saura or solar month, being equal to the sun's passage through a sign of the zodiac; there is also a Savan month, consisting of thirty risings and settings of the sun; a Nākshatra month, or month regulated by the lunar asterisms, and a fifth description of month called Vārhaspatya, depending on the motions of the planet JUPITER; the lunar month also, being of two kinds, as reckoned from the new or from the full moon, completes six different modes of monthly computation. 	 2.
