मेनाधव: मेनाधव m. (-वः) Himālaya the personified mountain and father of DURGĀ as PĀRVATĪ.  E. मेना the wife of the mountain, and धव husband.
मेन्धी: मेन्धी f. (-न्धी) A plant, from the leaves of which a reddish dye is pre-pared, with which the palms of the hands, tips of the fingers, soles of the feet, and finger nails are stained, (Lawsonia inermis;) also मेन्धिका । मा लक्ष्मीः इध्यते यया इन्ध् घञ् गौरा० ङीष् “मेइदी ।”
मेप्: मेप् (ऋ) मेपृ r. 1st cl. (मेपते) 	 1. To go, to move. 	 2. To serve.
मेब्: मेब् (ऋ) मेबृ r. 1st cl. (मेबते) To serve.
मेय: मेय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Measurable, what is to be measured.  E. मा to measure, यत् aff.
मेरक: मेरक m. (-कः) An Asura and foe to VISHṆU.
मेरु: मेरु m. (-रुः) 	 1. The sacred mountain Meru, in the centre of the seven continents, compared to the cup or seed-vessel of the lotus, the leaves of which are formed by the different Dwipas: its height is said by the Hindus to be 84,000 Yojanas, sixteen thousand of which are below the surface of the earth: the shape is various-ly described, as square, conical, columnar, spherical, or spiral; and the four faces of it are of various colours, or white towards the east, yellow to the south, black to the west, and red towards the north: the river Ganges falls from heaven on its summit, and flows thence to the surrounding worlds in four streams; the southern branch is the Ganges of India, the northern running into Tartary is the Bhadrasomā, the eastern is the Sitā, and the wes-tern the Chacshu or Oxus: on the summit of Meru BRAHMĀ re-sides attended and worshipped by the Rishis, Gandharbas, &c.; the regents of the points of the compass occupy the correspond-ing faces of the mountain, the whole of which consists of gold and gems: considered in any but a fabulous light, mount Meru appears to mean the high land of Tartary, immediately to the north of the Himālaya mountains. 	 2. The central bead in a rosary. 3. The middle gem in a necklace.  E. मि to scatter, (radiance,) Unādi aff. रु.
मेरुक: मेरुक m. (-कः) Fragrant resin, incense.  E. मेरु mount Meru, कन् aff. “यक्षधूपे ।”
मेरुयन्त्र: मेरुयन्त्र n. (-न्त्रं) A spindle.  E. मेरु and यन्त्र implement.
मेल: मेल mf. (-लः-ला) Meeting, union, assemblage; in the modern dialects, applied to a large concourse of people collected at stated periods for religious or commercial purposes, as at Haridwār, &c. 	 f. (-ला) 1. Ink. 	 2. Antimony or any collyrium. 	 3. Union, intercourse. 	 4. A company, a society. 	 5. The indigo-plant. 	 6. A musical scale. E. मिल to mix, to meet, aff. घञ्; also with ल्युट् aff. मेलन ।
मेलक: मेलक m. (-कः) Meeting, union, assemblage.  E. मेल the same, कन् added.
मेलन: मेलन n. (-नं) Meeting assembling. 	 2. Encounter. 	 3. Associating with. 4. Mixing with 5. Adding to.  E. मिल to mix, ल्युट् aff.
मेलयत्: मेलयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Mixing, adding, or causing to be mixed with, or added to.  E. मिल् to mix, causal v., शतृ aff.
मेलानन्द: मेलानन्द mf. (-न्दः-न्दा) An inkstand.  E. मेला ink, आनन्द delighting.
मेलान्धु: मेलान्धु f. (-न्धुः) An inkstand.  E. मेला ink, अन्धु a well.
मेलाम्बु: मेलाम्बु m. (-म्बुः) An inkstand.  E. मेला ink, अम्बु water.
मेव्: मेव् (ऋ) मेवृ r. 1st cl. (मेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
मेष: मेष m. (-षः) 	 1. A ram. 	 2. The sign Aries. 	 3. A kind of drug. 	 f. (-षा) A sort of small cardamom, brought from Guzerāt. 	 f. (-षी) An ewe.  E. मिष् to contend with, aff. अच् ।
मेषविषाणिका: मेषविषाणिका f. (-का) A plant: see मेढ्रशृङ्गी.  E. मेष a ram, विषाण a horn, कन् aff., fem. form.
मेषशृङ्ग: मेषशृङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A sort of poison. 	 f. (-ङ्गी) A kind of creeping plant, (Asclepias geminata, &c.;) see मेढ्रशृङ्गी.  E. मेष a ram, शृङ्ग horn.
मेषाक्षिकुसुम: मेषाक्षिकुसुम m. (-मः) A sort of Cassia, (C. tora.)  E. मेष a ram, अक्षि the eye, and कुसुम a flower; which is compared to a sheep's eye; also analogous terms as मेषलोचन, &c.; it is also read मेषाख्य and मेषाह्व, &c., as being named from the Mesa or ram. “चक्रमर्दे ।”
मेषाण्ड: मेषाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) INDRA.  E. मेष a ram, and अण्ड the testicle.
मेषालु: मेषालु m. (-लुः) A sort of shrub, commonly Ververa or Barbari, (Ocimum pilosum.)  E. मेष a ram, and आलु esculent root.
मेषिका: मेषिका f. (-का) An ewe.  E. मेषी an ewe, कन् aff.
मेह: मेह m. (-हः) 	 1. Urinary disease, especially inflammatory affection of the urethra, including gonorrhœa, &c. 	 2. A ram. 	 3. A goat. 	 4. Urine, piss.  E. मिह् to pass as urine, aff. घञ् ।
मेहत्: मेहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) Urining, passing urine.  E. मिह् to urine, शतृ aff.
मेहन: मेहन n. (-नं) 	 1. Membrum virile. 	 2. Urine, piss. 	 3. Passing urine, pissing.  E. मिह् to urine, aff. ल्युट्.
मेहिन्: मेहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) 	 1. Urining. 	 2. Suffering from urinary affec-tions.  E. मेह, इनि aff.
मैत्र: मैत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) Of or belonging to a friend, friendly, amicable. m. (-त्रः) 	 1. A Brāhmana. 	 2. A mixed caste. 	 3. The anus. 	 nf. (-त्रं-त्री) 	 1. Friendship. 	 2. Evacuation of excrement. 	 3. Union. 	 4. A name of the seventeenth lunar asterism, (see the next.)  E. मित्र a friend, or the sun and अण् aff.
मैत्रभ: मैत्रभ n. (-भं) The seventeenth lunar asterism; also ANURĀDHĀ.  E. मित्र the deity, presiding over the asterism, अण् aff. of relation, मैत्र be-longing to Mitra, and भ an asterism.
मेत्रावरुण: मेत्रावरुण m. (-णः) 	 1. A name of the saint AGASTYA. 	 2. VĀLMĪKI. 	 3. One of the officiating priests at a sacrifice.  E. मित्र the sun, वरुण the deity of water, अण् aff.
मैत्रावरुणि: मैत्रावरुणि m. (-णिः) 	 1. A name of AGASTYA. 	 2. VĀLMĪKI. 	 3. VAŚISTHA. E. मित्रवरुण a sage, the father of this saint, and इञ् aff.; or मित्र the sun, and वरुण VARUṆA, alluding to a legend of the birth of the saint from a contest between these deities, for the posses-sion of URVASĪ, one of the courtezans of INDRA'S heaven.
मैत्रीवल: मैत्रीवल m. (-लः) A Buddha or Bauddha deified saint.
मैत्रेय: मैत्रेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Of or relating to a friend. 	 m. (-यः) 	 1. A man of a mixed caste, the son of a Vaideha by an Ayogava mother: his business is to announce the hours in verse. 	 2. The seventh Bud-dha, or one still to come. 	 3. The name of a saint or Muni, the disciple of PARĀSARA, to whom the Vishṇu Purāna is narra-ted.  E. मित्र a proper name, or मित्र a friend, and ढक् aff. of descent or relation.
मैत्रेयक: मैत्रेयक m. (-कः) A crier or chaunter of the hours: see the last.  E. मैत्रेय, कन् added.
मैत्रेयिका: मैत्रेयिका f. (-का) The contest of friends or allies.  E. मैत्रेय relating to friends, वुञ् aff. of animosity.
मैत्र्य: मैत्र्य nf. (-त्र्यं-त्री) Friendship.  E. मित्र friend, ष्यञ् aff. of property, fem. aff. ङीष्, and the semi-vowel of the aff. rejected.
मैथिल: मैथिल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Belonging to, born in, &c. Mithilā. 	 f. (-ली) A name of ŚITĀ.  E. मिथिला, अण् aff.
मैथुन: मैथुन n. (-नं) 	 1. Copulation. 	 2. Union, association. 	 3. Marriage.  E. मिथुन a couple, aff. अण् ।
मैथुनज्वर: मैथुनज्वर m. (-रः) The excitement of sexual passion.
मैनाक: मैनाक m. (-कः) A mountain, or rock in the sea between the southern end of the Peninsula, and Lankā.  E. मेनका the wife of Himālaya, अण् aff. of descent, being in mythology her son.
मैनाकस्वसृ: मैनाकस्वसृ f. (-सा) The goddess DURGĀ as PĀRVATĪ.  E. मैनाक, स्वसृ sister.
मैनिक: मैनिक m. (-कः) A fisherman.  E. मीन a fish, and ठन् aff.
मैन्द: मैन्द m. (-न्दः) The name of a demon killed by KRISHṆA.
मैन्दहन्: मैन्दहन् m. (-हा) KRISHṆA.  E. मैन्द as above, and हन् destroyer.
मैरेय: मैरेय n. (-यं) A sort of spirituous liquor, prepared from the blossoms of the Lythrum fruticosum, with sugar, &c.  E. मिरा said to be the name of a country or drug, ढक् aff.
मोक: मोक n. (-कं) The cast-off skin of an animal.
मोक्तव्य: मोक्तव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be loosed or let go, to be liberated. E. मुच् to let go, तव्य aff.
मोक्ष्: मोक्ष् r. 1st and 10th cls. (मोक्षति मोक्षयति-ते) To let go, to release, to dis-charge, to send, to cast or throw.
मोक्ष: मोक्ष m. (-क्षः) 	 1. Final and eternal happiness, the liberation of the soul from the body, and its exemption from further transmigration. 2. Death. 	 3. Libertion, freedom. 	 4. Loosening, untying. 	 5. End of an eclipse. 	 6. Scattering. 	 7. Shooting. 	 8. A plant commonly Ghaṇtāpārali. 	 9. Acquittance of an obligation, as by a son to his father.  E. मोक्ष् to let loose or free, aff. अच्.
मोक्षक: मोक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what sets at liberty. 	 m. (-कः) A deli-verer, a liberator.  E. मोक्ष्, ण्वुल् aff.
मोक्षण: मोक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Letting go or free, liberating. 	 2. Squandering. 	 3. Giving up. 	 4. Causing to flow.  E. मोक्ष् to let go, ल्युट् aff.
मोक्षणीय: मोक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be, or what may be liberated.  E. मोक्ष, अनी-यर् aff.; also मोक्ष्य, and मोक्षितव्य ।
मोक्षित: मोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Let go, liberated.  E. मोक्ष, and क्त aff.
मोक्षोपाय: मोक्षोपाय m. (-यः) A sage, a devotee.  E. मोक्ष emancipation, उपाय means.
मोघ: मोघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) 	 1. Vain, useless, fruitless. 	 2. Left, abandoned. 3. Idle. 	 f. (-घा) Trumpet-flower, (Bignonia suave olens.) 	 m. (-घः) A fence, a hedge.  E. मुह् to be foolish, aff. अच् and the final changed.
मोघकर्मन्: मोघकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Following vain practices, observing useless ceremonies.  E. मोघ, कर्म्मन् act.
मोघकर्म्मन्: मोघकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Following vain practices, observing useless ceremonies.  E. मोघ, कर्म्मन् act.
मोघज्ञान: मोघज्ञान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cultivating vain knowledge or any but re-ligious wisdom.  E. मोघ, and ज्ञान knowledge.
मोघाश: मोघाश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) Indulging vain hopes.  E. मीघ, and आशा hope.
मोघोली: मोघोली m. (-ली) A fence, a hedge.
मोच: मोच m. (-चः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) 	 f. (-चा) 	 1. The silk-cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 	 2. The plantain, (Musa sapientum.) 	 3. The indigo-plant. 	 n. (-चं) A plantain, (the fruit.) E. मुच् to loose, aff. अच् ।
मोचक: मोचक m. (-कः) 	 1. A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) 	 2. The silk-cotton tree. 	 3. The plantain tree. 	 4. A plant, commonly Ghantāpāralī. 5. A devotee, one who has divested himself of worldly passion and desire. 	 6. A liberator.  E. मुच् to be let loose, aff. ण्वुल्; or causal form, aff. अच्, and कन् added.
मोचन: मोचन n. (-नं) Liberating, setting free.  E. मुच् to be free, ल्युट् aff.
मोचनीय: मोचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-य) 	 1. To be liberated or let loose. 	 2. To be resign-ed or given up.  E. मुच् to be loose, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
मोचरस: मोचरस m. (-सः) The gum of the silk-cotton tree.  E. मोच the Bombax, and रस juice; also similar compounds, as मोचनिर्य्यास, मोचसार, मोचस्राव, and मोचस्रुत् ।
मोचाट: मोचाट m. (-टः) 	 1. A kind of pungent seed, (Nigella Indica.) “कृष्णजीरके” 2. Sandal. 	 3. The heart of the plantain tree. 	 4. A plantain, (the fruit.)  E. मोच a plantain, &c. अट् to go, (to be used with, to resemble, &c.) aff. अच् ।
मोच्य: मोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्य) 	 1. To be let loose. 	 2. To be given up.  E. मुच् to be free, यत् aff.
मोटक: मोटक mn. (-कः-कं) A pill. 	 n. (-कं) Two broken blades of kuśa grass.
मोटकी: मोटकी f. (-की) One of the Rāginīs or female personification of the musical modes.
मोटन: मोटन m. (-नः) Air, wind. 	 n. (-नं) Rubbing, grinding, pressing.  E. मुट् to rub, &c. aff. ल्युट् ।
मोटनक: मोटनक n. (-कं) 	 1. Destruction. 	 2. A species of the Anushṭubh metre.
मोट्टायित: मोट्टायित n. (-तं) One of the ten Bhāvas, or properties of women, the silent expression of returned affection.
मोण: मोण m. (-णः) 	 1. Dried fruit. 	 2. A sort of water-fly, the crocodile-fly. 3. A basket for carrying snakes in.  E. मुण् to vow, aff. घञ् ।
मोद: मोद m. (-दः) 	 1. Joy, delight, happiness. 	 2. Fragrance.  E. मुद् to rejoice, aff. घञ् ।
मोदक: मोदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Delighting, rejoicing, causing happiness or de-light. 	 mn. (-कः-कं) A sort of sweetmeat. 	 m. (-कः) A mixed caste. E. मुद् to be glad, in the causal form, to make glad, and ण्वुल् aff.
मोदयत्: मोदयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Delighting, pleasing. 	 f. (-न्ती) 	 1. Arabian jasmine. 	 2. A wild sort of lovage, (Ligusticum ajwaen.)  E. मुद् to be pleased, causal form, aff. शतृ ।
मोदित: मोदित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pleased, delighted. 	 n. (-तं) Pleasure, delight. E. मुद् to rejoice, aff. क्त, and the vowel changed.
मोदिनी: मोदिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. Jasmine. 	 2. Musk. 	 3. Spiritious liquor.
मोरट: मोरट n. (-टं) 	 1. Root of sugar cane. 	 2. The blossom of the Alan-gium hexapetalum. 	 3. Milk of seven days standing, or when it has lost its milky nature. 	 f. (-टा) A sort of creeper, (Sanseviera zeylanica.)  E. मुर् to surround, aff. अटन् ।
मोष: मोष m. (-षः) 	 1. A robber. 	 2. Plundering. 	 3. Stolen property.
मोषक: मोषक m. (-कः) A thief.  E. मुष् to steal, ण्वुल् aff.
मोषण: मोषण n. (-णं) 	 1. Stealing. 	 2. Killing. 	 3. Cutting.  E. मुष्, and ल्युट् aff.
मोषयित्नु: मोषयित्नु m. (-त्नुः) 	 1. Brāhmana. 	 2. The kokila or Indian cuckoo.
मोषा: मोषा f. (-षा) Stealing, theft.  E. मुष् to steal, अङ् and टाप् affs.
मोह: मोह m. (-हः) 	 1. Fainting, loss of consciousness or sense. 	 2. Ignorance, folly, foolishness; it is applied especially to that spiritual igno-rance which leads men to believe in the reality of worldly objects, and to addict themselves to mundane or sensual enjoyment. 	 3. Pain, affliction. 	 4. Error, mistake. 	 5. Bewilderment, distraction. E. मुह् to be ignorant or foolish, aff. घञ् ।
मोहकलिल: मोहकलिल n. (-लं) The snare of illusion.
मोहन: मोहन mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं) Fascinating, stupefying, depriving of sense or understanding. 	 n. (-नं) 	 1. Copulation. 	 2. One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA. 	 3. Temptation, seduction, the overpower-ing of reason and reflection by worldly or sensual allurements. 4. A charm employed to bewilder an enemy. 	 m. (-नः) The thorn-apple, (Dhuturā.) 	 f. (-ना) 	 1. A sort of grass, (Trigonella cornicu-lata.) 	 2. A kind of jasmine, commonly the Tripura or Tipperāh jasmine.  E. मुह् to be foolish, causal form, aff. युच् or ल्युट् ।
मोहनक: मोहनक m. (-कः) The month of chaitra.
मोहनास्त्र: मोहनास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A weapon which fascinates the person against whom it is directed.
मोहित: मोहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Puzzled, perplexed. 	 2. Beguiled, deceived. E. मुह् to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.
मोहिन्: मोहिन् mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि) Illusive, fallacious, beguiling.  E. मोह, and इनि aff.; or मुह् to be foolish causal v., घिनुण् aff.
मोहिनी: मोहिनी f. (-नी) 	 1. A kind of jasmine, commonly Tripuramāli. 	 2. VISHṆU in the form of a fascinating woman. 	 3. A name of an APSARĀ.  E. मोह folly, इनि aff., and fem. aff. ङीष् ।
मौकुलि: मौकुलि m. (-लिः) A crow, some books have मीकलि.
मौक्तिक: मौक्तिक n. (-कं) A pearl.  E. मुक्ता a pearl, ठक् pleonastic aff.
मौक्तिकगुम्फिका: मौक्तिकगुम्फिका f. (-का) A woman who prepares strings of pearls.
मौक्तिकप्रसवा: मौक्तिकप्रसवा f. (-वा) The pearl-oyster.  E. मौक्तिक, and प्रसवा a mother.
मौक्तिकशुक्ति: मौक्तिकशुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A pearl-oyster.  E. मौक्तिक, a pearl शुक्ति an oyster.
मौक्य: मौक्य n. (-क्यं) Dumbness.  E. मूक. and ष्यञ् aff.
मौखर्य: मौखर्य्य nf. (-र्य्यं-र्य्यी) Scurrility, defamation.  E. मुखर foul-mouthed, ष्यञ् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
मौखर्य्य: मौखर्य्य nf. (-र्य्यं-र्य्यी) Scurrility, defamation.  E. मुखर foul-mouthed, ष्यञ् aff., fem. aff. ङीष्.
मौख्य: मौख्य n. (-ख्यं) Pre-eminence, precedence.  E. मुख chief, ष्यञ् aff.
मौग्ध: मौग्ध n. (-ग्धं) 	 1. Simplicity, silliness. 	 2. Ignorance. 	 3. A feminine pro-perty, asking a lover to tell what is already known.  E. मुग्ध, अण् aff.
मौच: मौच n. (-चं) The fruit of the banana tree.
मौञ्जी: मौञ्जी f. (-ञ्जी) The girdle of a Brāhmana made of three strings of Munja grass.  E. मुञ्जा, and अण् aff.
मौञ्चिबन्धन: मौञ्चिबन्धन n. (-नं) Investiture with the distinguishing cord.  E. मौञ्जि the girdle, and बन्धन binding; both being assumed at the same time.
मौढ्य: मौढ्य n. (-ढ्यं) Ignorance, folly, especially spiritual folly: see मोह. E. मूढ fool, ष्यञ् aff. of property.
मौण्ड्य: मौण्ड्य n. (-ण्ड्यं) Baldness, natural or artificial.  E. मुण्ड, and ष्यञ् aff.
मौत्र: मौत्र n. (-त्रं) A quantity of urine.
मौद्गीन: मौद्गीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Fit for or bearing, &c. kidney-beans.  E. मुद्ग kidney-bean, and खञ् aff.; also with अण् aff. मौद्ग ।
मौन: मौन n. (-नं) Silence, taciturnity.  E. मुनि a sage, (who practises,) अण् aff.
मौनव्रत: मौनव्रत n. (-तं) A vow of silence.
मौनिन्: मौनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Silent, taciturn. 	 m. (-नी) An ascetic, a hermit, a religious sage, one who has overcome his passions and retired from the world.  E. मौन silence, and इनि aff.
मौरजिक: मौरजिक m. (-कः) A player on a drum.  E. मुरज a drum, and ठक् aff.
मौर्ख्य: मौर्ख्य n. (-र्ख्यं) Stupidity, folly, fatuity.  E. मूर्ख a fool, ष्यञ् aff.
मौर्वी: मौर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) A bow-string.  E. मूर्व्वा the plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings are made, अण् and ङीष् affs.
मौर्व्वी: मौर्व्वी f. (-र्व्वी) A bow-string.  E. मूर्व्वा the plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings are made, अण् and ङीष् affs.
मौल: मौल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) 	 1. Radical, proceeding from a root or origin. 	 2. Of pure blood, descended from a respectable and primitive family without any improper intermixture.  E. मूल a root, and अण् aff.
मौलि: मौलि mf. (-लिः-लिः or ली) 	 1. A lock of hair on the crown of the head. 2. Hair ornamented and braided round the head. 	 3. A diadem, a tiara. 	 4. The head. 	 f. (-ली) The earth.  E. मूल the root or base, aff. इञ्; or मूल a name, and इञ् aff of descent; or मू to bind, लि aff., and the radical vowel changed.
मौष्टा: मौष्टा m. (-ष्टा) Boxing, sparring, playing at fisticuffs.  E. मुष्टि the fist, ण aff.
मौष्टिक: मौष्टिक m. (-कः) A rogue, a swindler.
मौसल: मौसल f. (-ली) Adj. Formed like a club. 	 2. Fought with clubs.
मौहूर्त: मौहूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) An astrologer.  E. मुहूर्त्त an hour, and अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. मौहूर्त्तिक ।
मौहूर्त्त: मौहूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) An astrologer.  E. मुहूर्त्त an hour, and अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. मौहूर्त्तिक ।
म्ना: म्ना r. 1st cl. (मनति) To fix in the memory by frequent practice or repetition, to study, to acquire by study, &c.
म्रक्ष्: म्रक्ष् r. 1st cl. (म्रक्षति) 	 1. To accumulate. 	 2. To smear, to anoint. r. 10th cl. (म्रक्षयति-ते) 	 1. To mix. 	 2. To combine 3. To speak incorrectly.
म्रक्ष: म्रक्ष m. (-क्षः) Slyness, hypocrisy, concealment of one's vice or defects. E. म्रक्ष् to anoint, aff. अच् ।
म्रक्षण: म्रक्षण n. (-णं) 	 1. Oil. 	 2. Smearing the body with fragrant oils or un-guents. 	 3. Heaping up.  E. म्रक्ष् to smear or anoint, ल्युट् aff.
म्रच्: म्रच् r. 1st. cl. (म्रचति) To go, to move.
म्रद्: म्रद् r. 1st cl. (म्रदते) 	 1. To grind, to pound, to reduce to powder or dust. 	 2. To tread or trample on.
म्रदिमन्: म्रदिमन् m. (-मा) Softness.  E. मृदु soft, and इमलिच् aff.
म्रदिमान्वित: म्रदिमान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 	 1. Soft. 	 2. Kind.  E. म्रदिमन्, अन्वित endowed with.
म्रदिष्ठ: म्रदिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very soft, exceedingly soft, softest.  E. मृद् soft, and इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative, ऋ changed to र ।
म्रदीयस्: म्रदीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Softer, milder.  E. मृदु soft, and ईयसुन aff. of the comparative, and the vowel changed to the semi-vowel.
म्रियमाण: म्रियमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Dying.  E. मृ to die, शानच् aff.
म्रुच्: म्रुच् (उ) म्रुचु r. 1st cl. (म्रोचति) To go, to move.
म्रुञ्च्: म्रुञ्च् (उ) म्रुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (म्रुञ्चति) To go, to move; also read म्रुनच् ।
म्रेट्: म्रेट् (ऋ) म्रेटृ r. 1st cl. (म्रेटति) To be mad.
म्रेड्: म्रेड् (ऋ) म्रेडृ r. 1st cl. (म्रेडति) To be mad.
म्लक्ष्: म्लक्ष् r. 10th cl. (म्लक्षयति-ते) 	 1. To mix, to unite. 	 2. To speak incorrectly.
म्लान: म्लान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 	 1. Foul, dirty. 	 2. Languid, weary. 	 3. Faded, withered. 	 4. Melancholy.  E. म्लै to be languid, aff. क्त ।
म्लानि: म्लानि f. (-निः) 	 1. Weariness, languor. 	 2. Foulness, filth. 	 3. Fading, decay. 	 4. Sadness.  E. म्लै to be languid, &c., aff. क्तिन् ।
म्लास्नु: म्लास्नु f. (-स्नु) 	 1. Growing languid. 	 2. Growing thin. 	 3. Growing withered.
म्लिष्ट: म्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 	 1. Indistinct, (as speech.) 	 2. Languid. 	 n. (-ष्टं) Indistinct speech.  E. म्लेच्छ् to speak indistinctly, aff. क्त ।
म्लुक्त: म्लुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Mixed, intermixed, inlaid, set.  E. म्लुच् to go, aff. क्त ।
म्लुच्: म्लुच्(उ)म्लुचु r. 1st cl. (म्लोचति) To go, to move. With अभि and नि pre-fixed. 	 1. To go down. 	 2. To set as the sun.
म्लुञ्च्: म्लुञ्च् (उ) म्लुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (म्लुञ्चति) To go, to move; also read म्लुन्च् ।
म्लेच्छ्: म्लेच्छ् r. 1st and 10th cls. (म्लेच्छति म्लेच्छयति-ते) To speak inarticulately or incorrectly, to use a provincial or barbarous dialect.
म्लेच्छ: म्लेच्छ m. (-च्छः) 	 1. The generic term for a barbarian or foreigner; that is, for one speaking any language but Sanskrit, and not subject to the usual Hindu institutions. 	 2. A sinner, a criminal. 	 3. Indis-tinct or barbarous speech.  E. म्लेच्छ् to speak inarticulately, aff. घञ् ।
म्लेच्छकन्द: म्लेच्छकन्द m. (-न्दः) Garlic.  E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and कण्ड root. “लशुने ।”
म्लेच्छजाति: म्लेच्छजाति m. (-तिः) A Mlechchha or barbarian or a man of an outcast race. The tribes enumerated under this head by MANU, but who are by him said to be properly, degraded Kshetriyas, appear to be chiefly the inhabitants of the countries bordering immediately upon India, both to the north and south: as far as modern re-search and similarity of appellation may be trusted, the tribes of Mlechchhas are as follows: the Pauṇḍrakas, (the people of pro-vinces bordering on Bengal and Bihar, and to the south of the Ganges,) Oḍras, (Urīyās,) Drāviras, (people of the southern part of the Coromandel coast,) Cāmbojas, (Arachosians,) Yavanas, (Greeks or Bactrians,) Śakas, (the people of the Sacha region or Sakai,) Pāravas, (Paropamisans,) Pahlavas, (the ancient Persians,) Chīnas, (Chinese,) Kirātas, (generally mountaineers, here per-haps especially the inhabitants of the Himālaya or Imaus,) Dera-das, (Daradæ,) and Khasas, (Scuthi or Chasas.) 	 n. (-च्छं) Copper. E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and जाति tribe, class.
म्लेच्छदेश: म्लेच्छदेश m. (-शः) The countries bordering on India, or those inhabi-ted by people of a different faith and language; defined to be any, where the black antelope is not found.  E. म्लेच्छ् a barbarian, an outcast, देश country.
म्लेच्छभोजन: म्लेच्छभोजन m. (-नः) Wheat. 	 n. (-नं) Half-ripe barley.  E. म्नेच्छ an outcast, भोजन food.
म्लेच्छमण्डल: म्लेच्छमण्डल n. (-लं) The country of the Mlechchhas or barbarians. E. म्लेच्छ, मण्डल region.
म्लेच्छमुख: म्लेच्छमुख n. (-खः) Copper.  E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and मुख countenance.
म्लेच्छवाच्: म्लेच्छवाच् mfn. (-वाक्) Speaking a barbarous dialect.  E. म्लेच्छ, वाच् speech.
म्लेच्छाश: म्लेच्छाश m. (-शः) Wheat.  E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, अश् to eat, aff. अच् ।
म्लेच्छास्य: म्लेच्छास्य n. (-स्यं) Copper.  E. म्लेच्छ a barbarian, and आस्व face, which would seem to allude to the fair complexion of the Greek or Maha-mmedan invaders of Hindusthan.
म्लेच्छित: म्लेच्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken incorrectly or barbarously. 	 n. (-तं) 	 1. Foreign or barbarous language. 	 2. Ungrammatical speech.  E. म्लेच्छ् a barbarian, इतच् aff.; or म्लेच्छ् to speak inaccurately, aff. क्त ।
म्लेट्: म्लेट् (ऋ) म्लेटृ r. 1st. cl. (म्लेटति) To be mad.
म्लेड्: म्लेड् (ऋ) म्लेडृ r. 1st. cl. (म्लेडति) To be mad.
म्लेव्: म्लेव् (ऋ,) म्लेवृ r. 1st cl. (म्लेवते) To serve, to gratify by service.
म्लै: म्लै r. 1st. cl. (म्लायति) 	 1. To be faint or languid, to yawn with languor or fatigue. 	 2. To fade, to decay. 	 3. To become thin. With परि, 1. To be dejected. 	 2. To wither. With प्र, 1. To fade. 	 2. To be dirty.
